records.purpose: Allocates a rounding difference in whole units of the last decimal place, proportionally to weights and biggest weight first, so that a set of rounded parts adds back exactly to the rounded whole.

operands.name: delta to distribute
operands.source: the difference between a rounded target and the sum of the rounded parts
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: weights
operands.unit_or_currency: the same currency, or any comparable quantity
operands.source: the raw amounts of the parts, or their rounded amounts in the realignment pass
operands.constraints: may be negative or all zero

operands.name: number of decimal places
operands.source: the currency
operands.constraints: zero or more

preconditions.condition: The weight list is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: The allocation is empty.

preconditions.condition: The delta is not zero at the precision given.
preconditions.otherwise: Every allocation is zero.

procedure: Return an empty allocation when the weight list is empty.
Set the step to ten raised to the power of minus the number of decimal places, and return an all-zero allocation when the delta is zero at that precision.

Set the sign to minus one when the delta is negative and plus one otherwise; set the number of units to the nearest integer to the absolute delta divided by the step; set the remaining units to that number.

Normalise the weights: take the absolute value of each, keep its original position, sort by absolute value descending, and divide each by the sum of all absolute values; when that sum is zero, every normalised weight is one divided by the number of weights.

Walk the normalised weights in that sorted order and allocate, for each, the smaller of the nearest integer to the normalised weight multiplied by the number of units and the remaining units; subtract what was allocated from the remaining units; add the sign multiplied by the allocated count and by the step to the allocation at that weight's original position; stop early when nothing remains.
Distribute the units still remaining one at a time, in the same sorted order, one unit to each; because the weights are normalised, the leftover can never exceed the number of weights.
records.formula: step = 10 ^ ( − decimal_places ) ; sign = −1 when delta < 0 , +1 otherwise ; units = nearest_integer( | delta | ÷ step ) ; normalised_weight_i = | weight_i | ÷ sum of | weight_j | , or 1 ÷ number_of_weights when that sum is 0 ; allocation_i = sign × step × minimum( nearest_integer( normalised_weight_i × units ) , remaining_units ) , taken in order of descending normalised weight ; the units still remaining are then given out one each, in the same order

rounding.what: The count of units allocated to each weight.
rounding.precision: Whole units of the last decimal place of the currency.
rounding.method: The nearest-integer rule of the host language, which rounds an exact one half to the even neighbour; the leftover pass then repairs the shortfall.
rounding.step: Inside the walk, once per weight; the leftover pass runs afterwards.

result.name: one allocation per weight, in the original positions
result.stored_or_displayed: Added to the rounded amounts of the redistribution passes and to the distribution shares.

edge_cases.case: The sum of the absolute weights is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Every normalised weight is one divided by the number of weights, so the delta is spread evenly.

edge_cases.case: Two weights are equal.
edge_cases.outcome: The sorted order preserves their original order, so the first of the two receives the leftover unit.

edge_cases.case: The nearest integer to a normalised weight times the number of units is exactly one half.
edge_cases.outcome: The host rounding takes the even neighbour, so nothing is allocated in the walk and the leftover pass places the unit.

edge_cases.case: The delta is zero at the precision given.
edge_cases.outcome: Every allocation is zero and no weight is touched.

edge_cases.case: The weight list is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The allocation is empty.

worked_examples.description: Three weights and a delta of three hundredths at three decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: The step is one thousandth, so there are thirty units to place. The sorted order is the first weight, then the two others. Twelve units go to the first, nine to each of the others; the three allocations are twelve thousandths, nine thousandths and nine thousandths, which add back to thirty units.

worked_examples.description: Two equal weights and a delta of one hundredth at two decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: One unit is to be placed. Each normalised weight is one half, and the nearest integer to one half of one unit is zero under the even-neighbour rule, so the walk allocates nothing and one unit remains. The leftover pass gives it to the first weight in sorted order.

records.name: Pass one of the document-wide rounding: plain rounding
records.purpose: Produces the first rounded figure of every amount of every base line, in both currencies, before any correction is applied.

operands.name: raw untaxed total of each base line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: raw base amount of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: raw tax amount of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: Every base line of the document has been computed on its own.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to round.

procedure: For each base line and for each of the two currencies, round the raw untaxed total to that currency.
For each tax entry of that line, round the raw base amount to that currency.
For each tax entry of that line, round the raw tax amount to that currency.
records.formula: total_excluded = round_to_currency( raw_total_excluded ) ; base_amount = round_to_currency( raw_base_amount ) for each tax entry ; tax_amount = round_to_currency( raw_tax_amount ) for each tax entry

rounding.what: The untaxed total of every base line and the base amount and tax amount of every tax entry.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency, and separately of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The first of the six document-wide passes.

result.name: the rounded amounts of the tax details block
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the tax details block and corrected by the later passes.

edge_cases.case: The document-wide method is round per line.
edge_cases.outcome: The raw amounts were already rounded during the single-line computation, so this pass changes nothing.

edge_cases.case: A currency has no decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: Each amount becomes a whole number of currency units.

worked_examples.description: Three identical lines of twelve point one two by twelve point one two with a twenty-three percent tax, under the round-per-tax method
worked_examples.narrative: Each raw base rounds to one hundred forty-six point eight nine and each raw tax to thirty-three point seven nine; their sums are four hundred forty point six seven and one hundred one point three seven, which the later passes correct.

records.name: Pass two of the document-wide rounding: applying manual amounts
records.purpose: Replaces the rounded amounts by the values a caller pinned, so that a frozen total, a global discount or a down payment cannot be moved by a recomputation.

operands.name: manual untaxed total in the line currency
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: manual untaxed total in the company currency
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: manual per-tax amounts
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the base line, as a table keyed by tax identifier carrying any of a base amount in the line currency, a base amount in the company currency, a tax amount in the line currency and a tax amount in the company currency
operands.constraints: optional; each entry replaces only the amount it names

operands.name: rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of line currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: used to derive a company-currency value from a line-currency manual value

operands.name: reverse-charge sign
operands.source: the tax entry
operands.constraints: minus one on a reverse-charge half, plus one otherwise

preconditions.condition: At least one manual value is set on the base line.
preconditions.otherwise: The pass leaves the line untouched.

procedure: For each base line and each currency, replace the rounded untaxed total by the manual untaxed total when one is set for that currency.
When the manual value was given in the line currency and a rate exists, recompute the company-currency untaxed total as that manual value divided by the rate, rounded to the company currency.

For each tax entry, and for the base amount and the tax amount independently, replace the rounded amount by the manual value multiplied by the reverse-charge sign and rounded to the currency, when a manual value exists for that tax.
When that manual value was given in the line currency and a rate exists, recompute the company-currency amount as the manual value divided by the rate, rounded to the company currency.
Leave the raw amounts untouched, so that the later passes can still compute a target.
records.formula: total_excluded_currency = manual_total_excluded_currency when set ; total_excluded = round_to_company_currency( manual_total_excluded_currency ÷ rate ) when only the line-currency value was set and a rate exists ; amount = round_to_currency( manual_value × reverse_charge_sign ) for each replaced base amount and tax amount ; amount_in_company_currency = round_to_company_currency( manual_value ÷ rate ) when only the line-currency value was set and a rate exists

rounding.what: Each replaced amount, and each company-currency amount derived from a line-currency manual value.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the currency being written.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The second of the six document-wide passes, after the plain rounding and before the totals with taxes are recomputed.

result.name: the pinned rounded amounts
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the tax details block; the redistribution passes then treat the manual values as their targets.

edge_cases.case: A manual value exists for the tax amount but not for the base amount.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the tax amount is replaced; the base amount keeps its plainly rounded value.

edge_cases.case: The entry is a reverse-charge half.
edge_cases.outcome: The manual value is multiplied by minus one before being written.

edge_cases.case: No rate exists on the line.
edge_cases.outcome: The company-currency amount is not derived from the line-currency manual value and keeps its plainly rounded value unless a company-currency manual value was set.

worked_examples.description: A pinned untaxed total of seven hundred on a line whose raw untaxed total is seven hundred point zero four, at a rate of one point two five
worked_examples.narrative: The rounded untaxed total in the line currency becomes exactly seven hundred; the company-currency figure is recomputed as seven hundred divided by one point two five, that is five hundred sixty, rounded to the company currency.

records.name: Pass three of the document-wide rounding: totals with taxes and zeroed deltas
records.purpose: Rebuilds each line's total with taxes from the amounts that survived the manual replacement, and clears the delta field that the fifth pass will write.

operands.name: rounded untaxed total of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: passes one and two
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rounded tax amount of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: passes one and two
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: Passes one and two have run.
preconditions.otherwise: The total with taxes would be built from amounts that a manual value is about to replace.

procedure: For each base line and each currency, set the delta of the untaxed total to zero.
Set the total with taxes to the rounded untaxed total plus the sum of the rounded tax amounts of every tax entry of the line.
records.formula: delta_total_excluded = 0 ; total_included = total_excluded + sum of the rounded tax amounts of every tax entry

rounding.what: Nothing new; the pass adds already-rounded amounts.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the currency the amounts are in.
rounding.method: Not applicable at this step.
rounding.step: The third of the six document-wide passes.

result.name: total with taxes of each base line, and a zeroed delta
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the tax details block; the total with taxes feeds the totals block and the included-mode targets of the redistribution passes.

edge_cases.case: The line carries no tax entry.
edge_cases.outcome: The total with taxes equals the rounded untaxed total.

edge_cases.case: The line carries a reverse-charge pair.
edge_cases.outcome: The two halves cancel in the sum, so the total with taxes equals the untaxed total.

worked_examples.description: A line whose rounded untaxed total is one hundred forty-six point eight nine with one tax of thirty-three point seven nine
worked_examples.narrative: The delta is cleared and the total with taxes becomes one hundred eighty point six eight.

records.name: Pass four of the document-wide rounding: redistributing the tax and base differences
records.purpose: Makes the sum of the rounded tax amounts of a tax equal the rounded sum of its raw amounts, and does the same for the bases, by moving whole units of the last decimal place between the entries of one group.

operands.name: grouping key
operands.source: the tax, the currency, the refund flag, the reverse-charge flag, the effective price inclusion and the computation key
operands.constraints: every tax entry of every base line is grouped by it

operands.name: raw tax amount of each entry
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: used both as target and as weight

operands.name: raw base amount of each entry
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: used both as target and as weight

operands.name: manual tax amount and manual base amount of each entry
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: when set, they replace the raw amount in the target

operands.name: rounded tax amount and rounded base amount of each entry
operands.source: passes one to three
operands.constraints: the values the delta is added to

preconditions.condition: The engine calls the pass in mixed mode.
preconditions.otherwise: The included or excluded mode would be forced for every group instead of being decided by each group's price inclusion.

preconditions.condition: The delta of a group is not zero at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: That group is left untouched.

procedure: Group every tax entry of every base line by the tax, the currency, the refund flag, the reverse-charge flag, the effective price inclusion and the computation key.

For each group and for each of the two currencies, compute the target tax amount as the sum over the group of the manual tax amount when one is set for that tax on that line and of the raw tax amount otherwise; for the company currency, when only a line-currency manual amount was set, use the already-rounded company amount instead.

Compute the tax delta as the rounded target tax amount less the sum of the rounded tax amounts, and, when it is not zero at the currency's precision, distribute it over the group's entries weighted by each entry's raw tax amount, adding each allocation to the corresponding rounded tax amount.
Compute the target base amount the same way.

In included mode, that is when the mode is mixed and the group is price-included or when the mode is explicitly included, compute the base delta as the rounded sum of the target base amount and the target tax amount, less the sum of the rounded base amounts plus the sum of the rounded tax amounts plus the tax delta.
In excluded mode, compute the base delta as the rounded target base amount less the sum of the rounded base amounts.
When the base delta is not zero, distribute it over the group's entries weighted by each entry's raw base amount, adding each allocation to the corresponding rounded base amount.
records.formula: delta_tax = round_to_currency( target_tax_amount ) − sum_of_rounded_tax_amounts ; included mode : delta_base = round_to_currency( target_base_amount + target_tax_amount ) − ( sum_of_rounded_base_amounts + sum_of_rounded_tax_amounts + delta_tax ) ; excluded mode : delta_base = round_to_currency( target_base_amount ) − sum_of_rounded_base_amounts ; each delta is distributed by the smooth distribution, weighted by the entries' raw tax amounts for the tax delta and by their raw base amounts for the base delta

rounding.what: The target tax amount and the target base amount of each group.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the group's currency, applied separately to each of the two currencies.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The fourth of the six document-wide passes; the target is rounded before the sum of the already-rounded amounts is subtracted from it.

result.name: corrected rounded tax amounts and base amounts
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the tax details block; they become the amounts of the tax journal items.

edge_cases.case: Every raw amount was already rounded, as under the round-per-line method.
edge_cases.outcome: The target equals the sum of the rounded amounts and the delta is zero.

edge_cases.case: Several entries carry the same raw amount.
edge_cases.outcome: The sorted order of the smooth distribution preserves their original order, so the correction lands on the first of them.

edge_cases.case: The two currencies need corrections of opposite direction.
edge_cases.outcome: They are computed independently and the allocations need not land on the same line.

edge_cases.case: A manual amount was set for a tax on a line.
edge_cases.outcome: It replaces the raw amount in the target, which is what keeps the document total exactly on the pinned figure.

worked_examples.description: Three lines with the same twenty-three percent tax, under the round-per-tax method, excluded mode
worked_examples.narrative: The target tax amount is three times thirty-three point seven eight five seven one two, that is one hundred one point three five seven one three six, which rounds to one hundred one point three six; the sum of the rounded amounts is one hundred one point three seven, so the delta is minus one hundredth and the three equal weights send it to the first entry. The base target is four hundred forty point six eight three two, rounding to four hundred forty point six eight against a sum of four hundred forty point six seven, so plus one hundredth goes to the first entry's base.

worked_examples.description: The same three lines with a twenty-one percent price-included tax, included mode
worked_examples.narrative: The tax target of eleven point two zero nine eight three four seven one rounds to eleven point two one against a sum of eleven point two two, so minus one hundredth goes to the first entry. In included mode the base target plus the tax target rounds to sixty-four point five nine while the current sum is fifty-three point three seven plus eleven point two two plus the tax delta of minus one hundredth, that is sixty-four point five eight, so plus one hundredth goes to the first entry's base.

records.name: Pass five of the document-wide rounding: redistributing the untaxed-total difference
records.purpose: Makes the sum of the base journal items' balances equal the rounded untaxed total of the document, by writing a per-line delta that the ledger balance adds to the rounded untaxed total.

operands.name: grouping key
operands.source: the currency, the refund flag and the computation key
operands.constraints: every base line is grouped by it

operands.name: raw untaxed total of each line
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: the weights in excluded mode and part of the target

operands.name: raw total with taxes of each line
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: the weights in included mode

operands.name: rounded untaxed total of each line
operands.source: passes one to four
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rounded tax amounts of each line
operands.source: passes one to four
operands.constraints: used by the included-mode delta

preconditions.condition: The pass is called in mixed mode by the engine.
preconditions.otherwise: The mode would not be decided by the group's own price inclusion.

preconditions.condition: In excluded mode, the target untaxed total is not exactly zero; in included mode, the target total with taxes is not exactly zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The group is skipped entirely.

procedure: Group every base line by the currency, the refund flag and the computation key.

Decide the mode of each group: start from included and switch to excluded as soon as one base line of the group carries a tax entry that is not price-included and whose tax amount is non-zero in at least one of the two currencies.

In excluded mode and for each currency, compute the delta as the rounded target untaxed total less the sum of the rounded untaxed totals, with the weights being each line's raw untaxed total, and skip the group when the target is exactly zero.

In included mode and for each currency, compute the delta as the rounded sum of the target untaxed total and the target tax amount, less the sum of the rounded untaxed totals plus the sum of the rounded tax amounts, with the weights being each line's raw total with taxes, and skip the group when the target total with taxes is exactly zero.
Distribute the delta by the smooth distribution and add each allocation to that line's delta of the untaxed total for that currency.
records.formula: excluded mode : delta = round_to_currency( target_total_excluded ) − sum_of_rounded_totals_excluded , weighted by each line's raw untaxed total ; included mode : delta = round_to_currency( target_total_excluded + target_tax_amount ) − ( sum_of_rounded_totals_excluded + sum_of_rounded_tax_amounts ) , weighted by each line's raw total with taxes ; the allocation is added to delta_total_excluded of the line ; accounting balance of a base line = rounded untaxed total + delta_total_excluded

rounding.what: The target untaxed total, and in included mode the sum of the target untaxed total and the target tax amount.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the group's currency, applied separately to each currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The fifth of the six document-wide passes; this is the only pass that writes the delta field.

result.name: the delta of the untaxed total of each base line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the tax details block; the accounting balance of a base line is always the rounded untaxed total plus this delta, never the rounded total alone.

edge_cases.case: A group's target is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The group is skipped and no delta is written.

edge_cases.case: Every tax of the group is price-included.
edge_cases.outcome: The group stays in included mode and the weights are the raw totals with taxes.

edge_cases.case: One line of the group carries a price-excluded tax with a non-zero amount.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole group switches to excluded mode.

edge_cases.case: Lines carry different computation keys.
edge_cases.outcome: They fall into different groups and never lend units of the last decimal place to each other.

worked_examples.description: Three lines of twelve point one two by twelve point one two with a twenty-three percent price-excluded tax, under the round-per-tax method
worked_examples.narrative: The rounded target is four hundred forty point six eight against a sum of rounded totals of four hundred forty point six seven, so one hundredth is allocated to the first line, whose balance becomes one hundred forty-six point nine zero.

worked_examples.description: Three lines of twenty-one point five three with a twenty-one percent price-included tax, included mode
worked_examples.narrative: The same delta of plus one hundredth lands on the first line's delta of the untaxed total, so the document's untaxed total is fifty-three point three eight rather than the fifty-three point three seven the rounded totals alone would give.

records.name: Pass six of the document-wide rounding: realigning on existing tax entries
records.purpose: Pulls the computed totals back onto the amounts a user typed by hand on an already-saved document, so that a recomputation does not silently overwrite them.

operands.name: supplied tax lines
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the existing tax journal items handed to the engine
operands.constraints: each carries its sign, its amount in each currency and its distribution line

operands.name: computed tax entries
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: passes one to five
operands.constraints: grouped by tax, currency and refund flag

preconditions.condition: The caller supplied existing tax lines, which happens whenever an already-saved document is recomputed.
preconditions.otherwise: The pass does nothing.

preconditions.condition: The group's current total is non-zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The group is skipped, because there is nothing to weight the distribution by.

procedure: Total the supplied tax lines by the tax, the currency and whether the distribution line is a refund one, summing the sign multiplied by the amount, separately in each currency.
Group the computed tax entries by the tax, the currency and the refund flag.
For each computed group that has a counterpart among the supplied totals and whose current total is non-zero, compute the delta as the supplied total less the current total.
Distribute that delta by the smooth distribution over the group's tax entries, weighted by their rounded tax amounts, and add each allocation to the corresponding rounded tax amount.
records.formula: supplied_total = sum over the supplied tax lines of the key ( tax , currency , the distribution line is a refund one ) of ( sign × amount ) ; delta = supplied_total − current_total ; the delta is distributed by the smooth distribution over the computed entries of the key ( tax , currency , refund flag ) , weighted by their rounded tax amounts

rounding.what: The allocations, in whole units of the last decimal place.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, inside the smooth distribution.
rounding.step: The sixth and last of the document-wide passes, after the untaxed-total delta has been written.

result.name: the realigned rounded tax amounts
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the tax details block; they become the updated amounts of the existing tax journal items.

edge_cases.case: A supplied tax line has no computed counterpart.
edge_cases.outcome: No realignment happens for it; the entry production later schedules it for deletion.

edge_cases.case: A computed group's current total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The group is skipped, because the weights would all be zero.

edge_cases.case: The document is being computed for the first time.
edge_cases.outcome: No tax lines are supplied and the pass does nothing.

worked_examples.description: A saved document whose single tax item was typed as twenty-one point five zero against a computed twenty-one point zero zero spread over two entries
worked_examples.narrative: The delta of fifty hundredths is distributed over the two entries weighted by fourteen and seven: fifty units of the last decimal place split two thirds and one third give thirty-three and seventeen, so the two amounts become fourteen point three three and seven point one seven, which add back to twenty-one point five zero.

records.name: Document totals under the round-per-line method
records.purpose: The first of the two document-wide rounding variants: every line is rounded on its own and the document total is the sum of the independently rounded line totals.

operands.name: quantity of each line
operands.source: the document lines
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: unit price after discount of each line
operands.source: the document lines
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax rate
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: currency rounding step
operands.source: the currency
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: The company's document-wide rounding method is round per line.
preconditions.otherwise: The round-per-tax variant applies.

procedure: Round each line's raw base to the currency step before any tax is computed.
Compute each tax on the rounded base and round the amount to the currency step immediately.
Convert each amount to the company currency and round it immediately.
Run the document-wide passes: because every raw amount is already rounded, the targets equal the sums of the rounded amounts and no delta is produced.
Add the independently rounded line figures to obtain the document figures.
records.formula: raw_base per line = round( quantity × unit_price ) ; tax per line = round( raw_base × rate ÷ 100 ) ; document untaxed total = sum of the rounded line untaxed totals ; document tax total = sum of the rounded line tax amounts ; document grand total = sum of the rounded line totals

rounding.what: The raw base of each line and each tax amount of each line, in both currencies.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Immediately during the single-line computation, before any document-wide pass; the passes then find no delta to distribute.

result.name: the document's untaxed total, tax total and grand total
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown in the totals block and posted as the journal items' balances.

edge_cases.case: Several identical lines.
edge_cases.outcome: Each carries the same rounded figures and the document total is a whole multiple of them.

edge_cases.case: A price-included tax pins the line total.
edge_cases.outcome: Both methods reach the same grand total, but they disagree on the split between the untaxed amount and the tax.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example seven, round per line: three lines of quantity twelve point one two at twelve point one two with a twenty-three percent price-excluded tax
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve point one two times twelve point one two is one hundred forty-six point eight nine four four, rounded to one hundred forty-six point eight nine; times zero point two three that is thirty-three point seven eight four seven, rounded to thirty-three point seven eight. Each line totals one hundred eighty point six seven and the document four hundred forty point six seven untaxed, one hundred one point three four of tax and five hundred forty-two point zero one in all.

worked_examples.description: The price-included variant: three lines of one unit at twenty-one point five three with a twenty-one percent price-included tax
worked_examples.narrative: Each line yields seventeen point seven nine untaxed and three point seven four of tax; the document shows fifty-three point three seven, eleven point two two and sixty-four point five nine.

records.name: Document totals under the round-per-tax method
records.purpose: The second of the two document-wide rounding variants: nothing is rounded during the single-line computation and the document total is the correctly rounded value of the exact arithmetic, with the difference redistributed over the lines.

operands.name: quantity of each line
operands.source: the document lines
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: unit price after discount of each line
operands.source: the document lines
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax rate
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: currency rounding step
operands.source: the currency
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: The company's document-wide rounding method is round per tax.
preconditions.otherwise: The round-per-line variant applies.

procedure: Compute every line at full precision, rounding nothing.
Round each raw amount once, in pass one.
In pass four, compute the target tax amount and the target base amount per group of tax entries and distribute the differences.
In pass five, compute the target untaxed total per group of base lines and write the difference into each line's delta.
Read the document untaxed total as the sum of the rounded untaxed totals plus their deltas, the document tax total as the sum of the corrected tax amounts, and the grand total as their sum.
records.formula: raw_base per line = quantity × unit_price ; raw_tax per line = raw_base × rate ÷ 100 ; rounded figures come from pass one ; delta_tax = round( sum of the raw tax amounts ) − sum of the rounded tax amounts ; delta_base = round( sum of the raw base amounts ) − sum of the rounded base amounts ; the deltas are distributed by the smooth distribution over the lines ; document untaxed total = sum of ( rounded untaxed total + delta ) ; document tax total = sum of the corrected tax amounts

rounding.what: Each raw amount once in pass one, and each target once in passes four and five.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Nothing is rounded in the single-line computation; the first rounding is pass one and the corrections are computed on rounded targets.

result.name: the document's untaxed total, tax total and grand total
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown in the totals block and posted as the journal items' balances.

edge_cases.case: The same document computed under the round-per-line method.
edge_cases.outcome: The untaxed total differs by one hundredth, the tax total by two hundredths and the grand total by three hundredths in the mandatory example.

edge_cases.case: A price-included tax pins the grand total.
edge_cases.outcome: Both methods reach the same grand total but split it differently between the untaxed amount and the tax.

edge_cases.case: The document is in a currency other than the company's.
edge_cases.outcome: The two currencies are rounded and redistributed independently and the allocations need not land on the same line.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example seven, round per tax: three lines of quantity twelve point one two at twelve point one two with a twenty-three percent price-excluded tax
worked_examples.narrative: Pass one rounds each line to one hundred forty-six point eight nine and thirty-three point seven nine. Pass four sends minus one hundredth of tax and plus one hundredth of base to the first line. Pass five sends plus one hundredth to the first line's delta. The document totals four hundred forty point six eight untaxed, one hundred one point three six of tax and five hundred forty-two point zero four in all, against four hundred forty point six seven, one hundred one point three four and five hundred forty-two point zero one under the round-per-line method.

worked_examples.description: The price-included variant: three lines of one unit at twenty-one point five three with a twenty-one percent price-included tax
worked_examples.narrative: The grand total is the same as under the round-per-line method because the price-included tax pins it, but the split differs: fifty-three point three eight against fifty-three point three seven untaxed, and eleven point two one against eleven point two two of tax. Fifty-three point three eight multiplied by zero point two one is eleven point two one nine eight, which agrees with the reported eleven point two one to within the same cent.

records.name: Document totals in two currencies
records.purpose: Shows that the line currency and the company currency are rounded and redistributed independently, so that each currency's document total is correct on its own.

operands.name: raw untaxed total of each line in the line currency
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of line currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: tax rate
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The document currency differs from the company currency and a rate is set.
preconditions.otherwise: The two sets of amounts coincide and one redistribution suffices.

preconditions.condition: The document-wide method is round per tax.
preconditions.otherwise: Every amount was already rounded during the single-line computation and no delta arises.

procedure: Compute the raw untaxed total and the raw tax amount of each line in the line currency.
Divide each by the rate to obtain the company-currency twins.
Round each of the four figures per line to its own currency in pass one.
Run passes four and five separately for each currency, computing each target from that currency's raw amounts.
Distribute each currency's delta over the lines independently.
records.formula: raw untaxed per line, company = raw untaxed per line, line currency ÷ rate ; raw tax per line, company = raw tax per line, line currency ÷ rate ; for each currency independently : delta_tax = round( sum of raw tax amounts ) − sum of rounded tax amounts and delta_untaxed = round( sum of raw untaxed totals ) − sum of rounded untaxed totals , each distributed by the smooth distribution

rounding.what: Every amount, once per currency.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and, separately, of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Pass one for the plain rounding, passes four and five for the targets; the two currencies never share an allocation.

result.name: the document totals in both currencies
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown in the totals block and posted as the amount in document currency and the balance of every journal item.

edge_cases.case: The two currencies need corrections in opposite directions.
edge_cases.outcome: Each is applied on its own, so a line may carry a plus in one currency and nothing in the other.

edge_cases.case: The rate is one.
edge_cases.outcome: The two sets of amounts coincide and both redistributions produce the same allocations.

worked_examples.description: Three lines of one unit at twenty-one point five three in a foreign currency, a twenty percent price-excluded tax, a rate of one point two five
worked_examples.narrative: In the foreign currency the tax target of twelve point nine one eight rounds to twelve point nine two against a sum of twelve point nine three, so minus one hundredth goes to the first line, and the untaxed target of sixty-four point five nine already equals the sum, so no untaxed delta arises. In the company currency the tax target of ten point three three four four rounds to ten point three three against a sum of ten point three two, so plus one hundredth goes to the first line, and the untaxed target of fifty-one point six seven two rounds to fifty-one point six seven against a sum of fifty-one point six six, so plus one hundredth goes to the first line's company untaxed delta.

records.name: Choosing the distribution and deriving the refund flag
records.purpose: Decides whether a base line uses a tax's invoice distribution or its refund distribution, which fixes the accounts, the factors and the report tags of every entry the line produces.

operands.name: refund flag of the base line
operands.source: derived from the document kind and, on a miscellaneous entry, from the sign of the line
operands.constraints: true or false

operands.name: document kind
operands.source: the host document
operands.constraints: customer invoice, customer credit note, vendor bill, vendor refund, miscellaneous entry or another kind

operands.name: debit and credit of the line
operands.source: the journal item, on a miscellaneous entry
operands.constraints: at most one is non-zero

operands.name: tax types carried by the line
operands.source: the taxes of the line
operands.constraints: sales, purchase or none

preconditions.condition: The tax has both an invoice distribution and a refund distribution of the same length, with the same kinds in the same order and the same percentages.
preconditions.otherwise: The tax is refused on save with "Invoice and credit note distribution should have the same number of lines." or "Invoice and credit note distribution should match (same percentages, in the same order)."

procedure: Set the refund flag to true when the document kind is a customer credit note or a vendor refund.
On a miscellaneous entry and on a line that is itself a tax entry, set the flag to true when its distribution line's document kind is the refund one.
On a miscellaneous entry whose line carries both a sales tax and a purchase tax, set the flag to true when the line has no credit, that is when it is a debit or zero.

On any other miscellaneous entry line, take the first tax only and set the flag to true when that tax is a sales tax and the line has no credit, or when it is a purchase tax and the line has no debit.
On a miscellaneous entry, invert the flag when the line carries taxes and the entry is itself the reversal of another entry.
Set the flag to false in every other case.
Use the tax's refund distribution when the flag is true and its invoice distribution otherwise.
records.formula: distribution_used = tax.refund_repartition_line_ids when base_line.is_refund is true , tax.invoice_repartition_line_ids otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The choice is made before any amount is split over distribution lines.

result.name: the distribution to use
result.stored_or_displayed: Determines the accounts, the factors and the report tags of every journal item the line produces.

edge_cases.case: A document is reversed twice.
edge_cases.outcome: The flag derived from the sign is inverted once per reversal, so the second reversal behaves like the original.

edge_cases.case: A miscellaneous entry line carries a sales tax and a purchase tax at once.
edge_cases.outcome: The mixed rule applies: the flag is true when the line has no credit.

edge_cases.case: A maintenance operation re-derives the tags of posted items on a miscellaneous entry.
edge_cases.outcome: It uses a simpler table: a sales tax on a balance of zero or less and a purchase tax on a balance of zero or more take the invoice distribution; a sales tax on a positive balance and a purchase tax on a negative balance take the refund one.

worked_examples.description: A customer credit note line of one unit at one thousand
worked_examples.narrative: The document kind alone sets the flag; the line uses the refund distribution and carries a sign of plus one, so the revenue item is a debit of one thousand.

worked_examples.description: A miscellaneous entry line of one thousand debit carrying one sales tax
worked_examples.narrative: The first tax is a sales tax and the line has no credit, so the flag is true and the refund distribution is used.

records.name: Splitting a tax amount over the distribution lines
records.purpose: Turns one tax amount into one share per distribution line, on the right account and with the right sign, and repairs the residue that independent rounding leaves.

operands.name: tax amount in the line currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: already corrected by the document-wide passes

operands.name: tax amount in the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: the same

operands.name: factor of each distribution line
operands.source: the distribution line's percentage divided by one hundred
operands.constraints: the factors of the non-negative lines total one hundred percent and those of the negative lines total minus one hundred percent

operands.name: reverse-charge sign
operands.source: the half being produced
operands.constraints: plus one on the positive half, minus one on the reverse-charge half

operands.name: target account of each distribution line
operands.source: the distribution line
operands.constraints: falls back to the base line's own account when the distribution line has none

preconditions.condition: The chosen distribution has at least one line of the tax kind.
preconditions.otherwise: The tax is refused on save with "Invoice and credit note repartition should have at least one tax repartition line."

preconditions.condition: The factors of the non-negative tax lines total one hundred and those of the negative ones total minus one hundred.
preconditions.otherwise: The tax is refused on save with "Invoice and credit note distribution should have a total factor (+) equals to 100." or the corresponding message for the negative total.

procedure: Select the distribution lines of the tax kind: for the positive half those whose factor is greater than or equal to zero, with a sign of plus one; for the reverse-charge half those whose factor is strictly negative, with a sign of minus one.
For each selected distribution line, multiply the tax amount in the line currency by the factor and by the sign and round to the line currency, and do the same in the company currency.
Take the account of the distribution line, falling back to the base line's own account.
Accumulate the shares and compute the difference between the tax amount and the accumulated total.
Sort the shares by decreasing absolute amount in the line currency, then by decreasing absolute amount in the company currency.
Distribute the difference by the smooth distribution, weighted by each share's own amount, and add the allocations back.
records.formula: share_in_line_currency = round_to_line_currency( tax_amount_in_line_currency × factor × sign ) ; share_in_company_currency = round_to_company_currency( tax_amount_in_company_currency × factor × sign ) ; delta = tax_amount − accumulated total of the shares ; the delta is distributed by the smooth distribution over the shares sorted by decreasing absolute amount, weighted by each share's own amount

rounding.what: Each share, independently, in each currency.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Each share is rounded as it is computed; the residue is redistributed immediately afterwards, so the shares always add back to the tax amount.

result.name: one share per distribution line, with its account
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Accumulated under the grouping key and posted as the amount in document currency and the balance of the tax journal items.

edge_cases.case: A distribution of plus one hundred and minus one hundred percent.
edge_cases.outcome: Two shares are produced, both equal to the tax amount, because the reverse-charge half already carries the negated amount and the sign of minus one negates it again; the ledger nets to zero while both report tags are stamped.

edge_cases.case: A distribution line has no account.
edge_cases.outcome: The share is posted on the base line's own account.

edge_cases.case: Rounding each share independently loses a unit of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: The residue redistribution puts it back, so the sum of the shares always equals the tax's rounded amount.

edge_cases.case: Two shares have the same absolute amount in the line currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The company-currency absolute amount breaks the tie in the sort.

worked_examples.description: A tax amount of one hundred split over three distribution lines of thirty-three point three three, thirty-three point three three and thirty-three point three four percent
worked_examples.narrative: Each share rounds exactly and the accumulated total already equals the tax amount, so no residue has to be redistributed.

worked_examples.description: A reverse charge of plus one hundred and minus one hundred percent on a tax amount of twenty-one
worked_examples.narrative: The positive line gives plus twenty-one. The reverse-charge half already carries minus twenty-one, and multiplying it by the factor of minus one and the sign of minus one gives minus twenty-one again on the deductible account, so the two items cancel while both tags are stamped.

records.name: The report tags of a base journal item
records.purpose: Builds the set of report tags stamped on the base item, which is what makes the line's amount appear in the base grids of the tax return.

operands.name: account tags of the product
operands.source: the product of the base line
operands.constraints: only the tags attached to the product

operands.name: tags of the base distribution line of each tax
operands.source: the chosen distribution of each tax
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: exigibility of each tax
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: based on invoice or based on payment

operands.name: request to include cash basis tags
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: false by default

preconditions.condition: The tax entry is not a reverse-charge half.
preconditions.otherwise: It contributes no base tag; only the positive half does.

preconditions.condition: The tax is exigible on the invoice, or the caller asked for cash basis tags to be included.
preconditions.otherwise: The tax contributes no base tag at invoice time; the tags are stamped later, on the cash basis entry.

procedure: Start with the account tags attached to the product, when the base line has a product.
Add, for every tax entry that is not a reverse-charge half and whose tax is exigible on the invoice, the tags of the base distribution line of the chosen distribution.
When the caller explicitly asked for cash basis tags to be included, add those tags for every tax entry that is not a reverse-charge half, whatever its exigibility.
records.formula: base_tags = product account tags ∪ ( union over the tax entries that are not reverse-charge halves and whose tax is exigible on the invoice , or over all of them when cash basis tags were requested , of the tags of the base distribution line of the chosen distribution )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Tags are set once, when the accounting data of the base line is derived.

result.name: the report tag set of the base journal item
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the base journal item and read by the tax return.

edge_cases.case: The base line has no product.
edge_cases.outcome: The tag set starts empty and only the distribution tags are added.

edge_cases.case: Every tax of the line is exigible on payment.
edge_cases.outcome: No base tag is stamped at invoice time; the tags reach the return only through the cash basis entries.

edge_cases.case: A tax has a negative distribution factor.
edge_cases.outcome: Its reverse-charge half contributes no base tag, while its positive half does.

worked_examples.description: A line with a product carrying no account tag and one sales tax of twenty-one percent exigible on invoice

base_distribution_line_tags: the tag of the base grid of the twenty-one percent sales rate

base_tags: the tag of the base grid of the twenty-one percent sales rate

worked_examples.narrative: The product adds nothing and the base distribution line adds its single tag.

worked_examples.description: The same line whose tax is exigible on payment
worked_examples.narrative: No tag is stamped at invoice time; the base tags are stamped on the cash basis entry when the invoice is paid.

records.name: The report tags of a tax journal item
records.purpose: Builds the tag set of a tax item, including the base tags a tax must inherit when it swells the base of a later tax, so that the later tax's base grid reports the earlier tax's amount.

operands.name: account tags of the product
operands.source: the product of the base line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tags of the distribution line
operands.source: the distribution line that produced the entry
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: base tags of every tax already seen
operands.source: the running set built while walking the entries backwards
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: affects base of subsequent taxes flag
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: base affected by previous taxes flag
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The tax is exigible on the invoice, or the caller asked for cash basis tags to be included.
preconditions.otherwise: Neither the distribution line's own tags nor the tax's base tags enter any set.

procedure: Walk the tax entries backwards, maintaining per tax the set of base tags of the taxes seen so far.
Start each tax entry's tag set with the account tags of the product.
Add the distribution line's own tags, but only when the tax is exigible on the invoice or the caller asked for cash basis tags to be included.
When the tax affects the base of subsequent taxes, also add the base tags of every other tax already recorded in the running set.

After processing the tax's entries, when the tax accepts being affected by previous taxes, record its own base tags in the running set, again only when it is exigible on the invoice or cash basis tags were requested.
records.formula: tax_entry_tags = product account tags ∪ ( distribution line tags , when exigible on invoice or cash basis tags requested ) ∪ ( the base tags of every other tax in the running set , when the tax affects the base of subsequent taxes ) ; after the entries of a tax are processed , running_set = running_set ∪ ( that tax's own base tags , when it accepts being affected by previous taxes and is exigible on invoice or cash basis tags were requested )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Tags are set once, when the accounting data is derived, walking the entries backwards.

result.name: the report tag set of each tax journal item
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the tax journal item; part of its grouping key, so two entries with different tag sets are never merged.

edge_cases.case: A tax affects the base of a later tax.
edge_cases.outcome: Its own item inherits the later tax's base tags, so its amount is reported inside that later tax's base grid.

edge_cases.case: The walk is done forwards instead of backwards.
edge_cases.outcome: The running set is empty when the affecting tax is reached and the inheritance is lost; the walk must be backwards.

edge_cases.case: The tax is exigible on payment and cash basis tags were not requested.
edge_cases.outcome: Its item carries only the product's account tags; the distribution tags are stamped on the cash basis entry instead.

worked_examples.description: A ten percent tax affecting the base of a five percent tax, both exigible on invoice

affecting_tax_distribution_tags: the tax grid tag of the ten percent rate
affected_tax_base_tags: the base grid tag of the five percent rate

tags_of_the_five_percent_item: the tax grid tag of the five percent rate
tags_of_the_ten_percent_item: the tax grid tag of the ten percent rate
the base grid tag of the five percent rate

worked_examples.narrative: Walking backwards, the five percent tax is processed first and, because it accepts being affected, its base tags enter the running set. The ten percent tax is processed next and, because it affects the base of subsequent taxes, it adds that base tag to its own item, so its ten is reported inside the five percent tax's base.

records.name: The grouping keys that merge tax entries into journal items
records.purpose: Decides which computed tax entries become one journal item, and which existing journal item an entry can update instead of being recreated.

operands.name: partner, currency, analytic distribution and account of the base line
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: set of base taxes of the base line
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: distribution line, originator group of taxes and account of the tax entry
operands.source: the tax entry
operands.constraints: the account falls back to the base line's

operands.name: set of downstream taxes the entry is subject to
operands.source: the base pass
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: set of report tags of the entry
operands.source: the tag rules
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: analytic flag of the tax and the tax-settlement flag of the distribution line
operands.source: the tax and the distribution line
operands.constraints: decide whether the analytic distribution stays in the key

preconditions.condition: The key of a computed entry and the key of an existing entry are built from the same fields in the same order.
preconditions.otherwise: They cannot be compared and every existing entry would be deleted and recreated.

procedure: Build the base part of the key from the base line: the partner, the currency, the analytic distribution, the account and the set of base taxes.

Build the full key of a tax entry by overriding and extending that base part with the distribution line, the partner, the currency, the originator group of taxes, the analytic distribution kept only when the tax is analytic or the distribution line is not used in the tax settlement and cleared otherwise, the account of the distribution line falling back to the base line's account, the set of downstream taxes the entry itself is subject to, the set of report tags, and a technical marker that keeps a zero line, false by default.

Build the key of an existing tax entry from the distribution line, the partner, the currency, the originator group of taxes, the analytic distribution, the account, the set of base taxes and the set of report tags.
Merge two computed entries into one journal item when their full keys are equal.
records.formula: base part of the key = ( partner , currency , analytic distribution , account , the set of base taxes ) ; full key of a tax entry = the base part overridden and extended with ( distribution line , partner , currency , originator group of taxes , analytic distribution kept only when the tax is analytic or the distribution line is not used in the tax settlement , account of the distribution line falling back to the base line's account , the set of downstream taxes , the set of report tags , the keep-zero-line marker ) ; key of an existing tax entry = ( distribution line , partner , currency , originator group of taxes , analytic distribution , account , set of base taxes , set of report tags )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Keys are built after the tags and before the amounts are accumulated.

result.name: the grouping key of each tax entry and of each existing tax journal item
result.stored_or_displayed: Used inside the engine to accumulate amounts and to match existing items; the technical parts of the key, whose names begin with a double underscore, are stripped before the keys are used to write records.

edge_cases.case: Two different taxes produce entries with the same key.
edge_cases.outcome: They are merged into one journal item; because the key includes the distribution line, this only happens for the same distribution line.

edge_cases.case: The tax is analytic, or the distribution line is not used in the tax settlement.
edge_cases.outcome: The analytic distribution stays in the key, so entries with different analytic distributions are not merged.

edge_cases.case: Neither holds.
edge_cases.outcome: The analytic distribution is cleared from the key and entries that differ only by it are merged.

edge_cases.case: An entry's amount is zero in both currencies.
edge_cases.outcome: It is dropped, unless its key carries the keep-zero-line marker.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of the same invoice carrying the same tax, the same partner, the same currency and the same account

inputs.tax: one twenty-one percent sales tax with a single distribution line of one hundred percent

worked_examples.narrative: The two entries share every component of the full key, so they accumulate into one journal item of sixty-three.

records.name: Producing the base and tax journal items
records.purpose: Turns the final amounts into the update of each base item and the accumulated amounts of each tax item, and decides which existing items are updated, deleted or created.

operands.name: rounded untaxed total and its delta of each base line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the document-wide rounding passes
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: sign of the base line
operands.source: the host document's direction
operands.constraints: plus one or minus one

operands.name: share of each distribution line
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the splitting step
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: base amount of the tax entry in company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: manual tax line name
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: optional; the tax's name is used when absent

operands.name: existing tax journal items
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: each carries its own key

preconditions.condition: The document-wide rounding passes have run.
preconditions.otherwise: The balances would not add up to the document totals.

procedure: For each base line, record the update it needs: its tag set and its balance in each currency, computed as the sign multiplied by the rounded untaxed total plus its delta.

For each share of each tax entry, accumulate under its grouping key the name, which is the manual tax line name when the base line carries one and the tax's name otherwise; the base amount, increased by the sign multiplied by the tax entry's base amount in company currency; the amount in document currency, increased by the sign multiplied by the share in line currency; and the balance, increased by the sign multiplied by the share in company currency.
Drop every accumulated entry whose amount is zero in both currencies, unless its key carries the keep-zero-line marker.
Strip every technical key, that is every key whose name begins with a double underscore.

Match against the supplied existing tax entries: an existing entry whose key is present in the accumulation and has not already been matched is scheduled for update with the accumulated amounts; every other existing entry is scheduled for deletion; every accumulated key left unmatched is scheduled for creation.
records.formula: amount_in_line_currency = sign × ( total_excluded_currency + delta_total_excluded_currency ) ; amount_in_company_currency = sign × ( total_excluded + delta_total_excluded ) ; tax_base_amount = tax_base_amount + sign × the tax entry's base amount in company currency ; amount_currency = amount_currency + sign × the share in line currency ; balance = balance + sign × the share in company currency

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts accumulated are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: The accumulation is exact addition of rounded amounts, which is why the invariants hold: the base items' balances add to the document's untaxed total and each tax's shares add to its rounded amount.

result.name: the base item updates and the tax item creations, updates and deletions
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Written to the journal entry; the balance of a base item is the rounded untaxed total plus its delta, never the rounded total alone.

edge_cases.case: An accumulated entry is zero in both currencies.
edge_cases.outcome: No journal item is produced, unless the key carries the keep-zero-line marker.

edge_cases.case: Two existing items share a key.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the first is matched and updated; the second is scheduled for deletion.

edge_cases.case: The base line carries a manual tax line name.
edge_cases.outcome: That name is used on the tax item instead of the tax's own name.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice line of one unit at one thousand with a twenty-one percent sales tax, sign minus one
worked_examples.narrative: The sign of minus one turns the revenue line into a credit of one thousand and the tax item into a credit of two hundred ten; the tax item's base amount records minus one thousand.

records.name: The amount a tax return grid reports for a tagged journal item
records.purpose: States how a report expression turns tagged balances into the figure a tax return shows, and therefore why the refund distribution must point at the oppositely signed expression.

operands.name: balances of the tagged journal items
operands.source: the posted journal items carrying the tag
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: report sign of the expression
operands.source: the report expression's formula
operands.constraints: minus one when the formula starts with a minus sign, plus one otherwise

preconditions.condition: The invoice distribution and the refund distribution of the tax point at report expressions of opposite sign.
preconditions.otherwise: An invoice and its credit note contribute in the same direction and the period's net figure is wrong; the shipped charts point the refund distribution at the negated expression so that they cancel.

preconditions.condition: The two distributions have the same length, the same kinds in the same order and the same percentages.
preconditions.otherwise: The tax is refused on save; only the accounts and the tags may differ.

procedure: Sum the balances of every journal item carrying the tag.
Read the report sign from the expression's formula: minus one when it starts with a minus sign, plus one otherwise.
Multiply the sum by that sign.
records.formula: reported_amount_on_the_grid = report_sign × sum of the balances of the tagged journal items , where report_sign = −1 when the expression's formula starts with a minus sign and +1 otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the balances are already rounded to the company currency.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when the balances were written.
rounding.step: The grid sums stored balances; it never rounds again.

result.name: the figure shown on the tax return line
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the tax return and used by the periodic settlement.

edge_cases.case: A sales tax whose base and tax items are credits.
edge_cases.outcome: The shipped sales grids use the negating form, so the report sign is minus one and the figures are shown as positive.

edge_cases.case: A credit note pointing at the same expression as the invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: Its contribution has the wrong direction; the refund distribution exists precisely so that it can point at the negated expression instead.

edge_cases.case: A refund distribution differing from the invoice one by more than its accounts and its tags.
edge_cases.outcome: It is refused on save, so a refund can never redistribute an amount differently from the invoice it reverses.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example ten: an invoice of one thousand at twenty-one percent and the credit note that reverses it

inputs.invoice_base_tag: the tag whose expression formula is the plain base expression
inputs.invoice_tax_tag: the tag whose expression formula is the plain tax expression
inputs.refund_base_tag: the same base tag reached through the negated expression
inputs.refund_tax_tag: the same tax tag reached through the negated expression

worked_examples.narrative: The invoice posts minus one thousand of revenue and minus two hundred ten of tax; the sales grid's expression carries a leading minus sign, so its report sign is minus one and the reported figures are plus one thousand and plus two hundred ten. The credit note posts plus one thousand and plus two hundred ten against the refund distribution's tags, whose expression is the oppositely signed one, so its contribution is minus one thousand and the period nets to zero.

records.name: Choosing the distribution when re-deriving the tags of a posted entry
records.purpose: Fixes which distribution the maintenance operation uses when it rebuilds the tag links of already-posted journal items after a tax's distribution has been edited.

operands.name: tax type
operands.source: the tax
operands.constraints: sales or purchase

operands.name: balance of the journal item
operands.source: the posted journal item
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: kind of the entry
operands.source: the journal entry
operands.constraints: invoice kind, refund kind, miscellaneous entry or cash basis entry

preconditions.condition: The operation is run by a user allowed to change the tags of posted items.
preconditions.otherwise: The permission checks of the domain refuse it.

procedure: For an invoice-kind document, use the invoice distribution; for a refund-kind document, the refund distribution.
For a cash basis entry, use the distribution the kind of its originating document selects.
For a miscellaneous entry with a sales tax and a balance less than or equal to zero, use the invoice distribution.
For a miscellaneous entry with a sales tax and a balance greater than zero, use the refund distribution.
For a miscellaneous entry with a purchase tax and a balance greater than or equal to zero, use the invoice distribution.
For a miscellaneous entry with a purchase tax and a balance less than zero, use the refund distribution.
records.formula: distribution_used = invoice when ( tax type is sales and balance ≤ 0 ) or ( tax type is purchase and balance ≥ 0 ) ; distribution_used = refund when ( tax type is sales and balance > 0 ) or ( tax type is purchase and balance < 0 )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The choice is made per journal item before its tags are rewritten.

result.name: the distribution whose tags are stamped
result.stored_or_displayed: The tag links of the posted journal items are rewritten from it.

edge_cases.case: A miscellaneous entry line with a sales tax and a balance of exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The invoice distribution is used, because the test is less than or equal to zero.

edge_cases.case: A miscellaneous entry line with a purchase tax and a balance of exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The invoice distribution is used, because the test is greater than or equal to zero.

edge_cases.case: A tax whose children belong to several parent groups is updated.
edge_cases.outcome: The operation is refused with "Update with children taxes that are child of multiple parents is not supported."

worked_examples.description: A miscellaneous entry line of one thousand credit carrying a sales tax
worked_examples.narrative: A credit gives a negative balance, which is less than or equal to zero, so the invoice distribution is used.

records.name: Freezing the current result into manual amounts
records.purpose: Writes the current rounded figures back into the manual inputs, so that recomputing the document cannot move a total that a discount or a down payment has fixed.

operands.name: rounded untaxed totals and their deltas
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the document-wide rounding passes
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rounded base amount and tax amount of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the document-wide rounding passes
operands.constraints: reverse-charge halves are skipped

operands.name: filter predicate
operands.source: the caller
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: The base line carries at least one tax entry.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is frozen for that line.

procedure: For each base line with at least one tax entry, set the manual untaxed total of each currency to the rounded untaxed total plus its delta.
For each tax entry that is not a reverse-charge half, set the manual base amount and the manual tax amount of each currency to the current rounded values.
When a filter is supplied, write an empty entry, rather than no entry, for every tax the filter rejects.
records.formula: manual_total_excluded_currency = total_excluded_currency + delta_total_excluded_currency ; manual_total_excluded = total_excluded + delta_total_excluded ; manual base and tax amounts of a tax = the current rounded base and tax amounts of that tax , in both currencies ; the targets of the redistribution passes then fall back to the manual values where they exist and to the raw values elsewhere

rounding.what: Nothing new; the values written are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: After the six document-wide passes, so that the frozen figures include the deltas.

result.name: the manual inputs of the base line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored in the structured document held on the journal item and reapplied by pass two of every later recomputation.

edge_cases.case: A tax is rejected by the filter.
edge_cases.outcome: An empty entry is written for it, which is different from writing no entry: the later import test counts the taxes in the stored table.

edge_cases.case: A tax entry is a reverse-charge half.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped; the positive half's manual values carry the pair.

edge_cases.case: The untaxed total carried a delta.
edge_cases.outcome: The frozen manual total includes it, so the balance is preserved exactly.

worked_examples.description: Freezing a line whose rounded untaxed total is one hundred forty-six point eight nine with a delta of one hundredth and one tax of thirty-three point seven eight
worked_examples.narrative: The manual untaxed total is the rounded total plus the delta, one hundred forty-six point nine zero, and the per-tax manual amounts are the current rounded base and tax.

records.name: Partitioning a document into independent rounding subsets by computation key
records.purpose: Keeps a down payment deduction or a global discount from lending units of the last decimal place to the ordinary lines, so that each subset is rounded correctly on its own.

operands.name: computation key of each base line
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: empty, or a key beginning with the global discount marker or the down payment marker, each optionally suffixed

operands.name: untaxed totals of the lines of each subset
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the single-line computation
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: Both redistribution passes include the computation key in their grouping.
preconditions.otherwise: Cents leak across subsets and the down payment deduction or the discount is inflated or deflated by a unit of the last decimal place.

procedure: Read the computation key of each base line.
Mark a line whose key begins with the global discount marker with the corresponding special type, and a line whose key begins with the down payment marker with its own special type.
Include the key in the grouping of the fourth pass and of the fifth pass, so that lines of different keys never share a delta.
Round and redistribute each subset independently.
records.formula: grouping key of pass four = ( tax , currency , refund flag , reverse-charge flag , effective price inclusion , computation key ) ; grouping key of pass five = ( currency , refund flag , computation key ) ; document total = sum over the subsets of each subset's own correctly rounded total

rounding.what: Each subset's totals, separately.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: In passes four and five, once per subset.

result.name: the per-subset rounded totals and the document total that is their sum
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown in the totals block and posted as the journal items' balances.

edge_cases.case: A final invoice deducting a previous down payment.
edge_cases.outcome: The ordinary lines carry no key and total one thousand while the negative down payment lines carry the down payment key and total minus three hundred; the invoice shows exactly seven hundred.

edge_cases.case: A key carries a suffix.
edge_cases.outcome: It is still a distinct key, so several down payments are rounded independently of each other.

edge_cases.case: Every line carries the same key.
edge_cases.outcome: The partition has one subset and the behaviour is the ordinary one.

worked_examples.description: A final invoice of one thousand deducting a down payment of three hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Each subset is rounded on its own; their totals add to exactly seven hundred and no unit of the last decimal place moves from one subset to the other.

records.name: Restoring stored manual amounts at the current rate
records.purpose: Re-expresses manual company-currency amounts captured at one exchange rate so that they remain correct when the document is recomputed at another.

operands.name: stored company-currency amount
operands.source: the structured document stored on the journal item
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: current rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of line currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the base line
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: stored rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of line currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the snapshot taken when the manual values were captured
operands.constraints: may be absent
