preconditions.condition: A stored manual per-tax table exists.
preconditions.otherwise: Only the computation key is restored and no manual value is applied.

preconditions.condition: The base line's currency is the stored currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual values are not restored.

preconditions.condition: The base line's unit price equals the stored unit price at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual values are not restored.

preconditions.condition: The base line's discount equals the stored discount at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual values are not restored.

preconditions.condition: The base line's quantity equals the stored quantity at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual values are not restored.

preconditions.condition: The number of flattened taxes on the base line equals the number of taxes in the stored table, and every flattened tax is present in that table.
preconditions.otherwise: The manual values are not restored.

procedure: Always restore the computation key.
Check the seven conditions; restore the manual values only when all of them hold.
Replace the base line's unit price by the stored unit price.
Compute the rate change as the current rate divided by the stored rate, or one when either rate is absent.
Divide every stored company-currency amount by that rate change.
Restore every line-currency amount unchanged.
records.formula: rate_change = current_rate ÷ stored_rate , or 1 when either rate is absent ; restored_company_amount = stored_company_amount ÷ rate_change ; restored line-currency amounts = the stored values unchanged

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the restored amounts are re-rounded by pass two when they are applied.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency, in pass two.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The re-expression happens while the base line is being prepared, before the engine runs.

result.name: the restored manual amounts and computation key
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Merged into the base line and applied by pass two of the document-wide rounding.

edge_cases.case: Either rate is absent.
edge_cases.outcome: The rate change is one and the stored company amounts are restored unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The user changed the quantity after the amounts were frozen.
edge_cases.outcome: The quantity test fails, no manual value is restored and the engine recomputes freely.

edge_cases.case: The document is reversed.
edge_cases.outcome: The stored data is deep-copied and the quantity, both manual untaxed totals and every manual base and tax amount in both currencies are negated.

edge_cases.case: A tax was added to the line after the freeze.
edge_cases.outcome: The count of flattened taxes no longer matches the stored table and no manual value is restored.

worked_examples.description: A manual company amount of five hundred sixty captured at a rate of one point two five and restored at a rate of one point five
worked_examples.narrative: One point five divided by one point two five is one point two; five hundred sixty divided by one point two is four hundred sixty-six point six six six recurring, which pass two rounds to the company currency when it writes it.

records.name: Turning a refund base line back into a normal one
records.purpose: Produces, from a base line marked as a refund, an equivalent line that is not, so that a consumer can treat every line of a set as pointing the same way whatever the document kind.

operands.name: quantity
operands.source: the refund base line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: the four totals of the tax details block
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: raw and rounded

operands.name: the two deltas of the untaxed total
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: the four base and tax amounts of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: raw and rounded

preconditions.condition: The base line is marked as a refund.
preconditions.otherwise: The helper is not needed and the line is used as it stands.

procedure: Negate the quantity.
Clear the refund flag.
Negate the four totals of the tax details block, both raw and rounded, in both currencies.
Negate both deltas of the untaxed total.
Negate each tax entry's four base and tax amounts, raw and rounded, in both currencies.
records.formula: quantity = − quantity ; is_refund = false ; every amount of the tax details block a = − a , namely the raw and rounded untaxed totals and totals with taxes in both currencies , both deltas , and each tax entry's raw and rounded base and tax amounts in both currencies

rounding.what: Nothing; negation is exact.
rounding.precision: The amounts keep the precision they already had.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding step is involved.

result.name: an equivalent base line that is not a refund
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Handed to the consumer; never stored in place of the original.

edge_cases.case: The line carries a delta from the fifth pass.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta is negated too, so the balance of the converted line is the exact opposite of the original's.

edge_cases.case: The line carries a reverse-charge pair.
edge_cases.outcome: Both halves are negated, so the pair still cancels.

worked_examples.description: A credit note line of one unit at one thousand with a twenty-one percent tax
worked_examples.narrative: Every amount changes sign and the quantity becomes minus one, so the converted line describes the same transaction pointing the other way.

records.name: The global amounts of the totals block
records.purpose: Produces the untaxed amount and the tax amount a document shows, in both currencies, from the rounded base lines.

operands.name: rounded untaxed total of each base line and its delta
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the document-wide rounding passes
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rounded tax amount of each tax entry
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the document-wide rounding passes
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The document-wide rounding passes have run on every base line.
preconditions.otherwise: The block would show totals that do not match the journal items.

procedure: Aggregate every base line under a single key that is present only when the line has at least one tax entry.
Sum, over all keys and in both currencies, each line's untaxed total including its delta into the block's untaxed amount.
Sum, over all keys and in both currencies, every tax amount into the block's tax amount.
Set the flag saying that tax groups are involved when at least one key was non-empty.
records.formula: block.base_amount = sum over the base lines of ( total_excluded + delta_total_excluded ) , per currency ; block.tax_amount = sum over every tax entry of every base line of tax_amount , per currency ; block.has_tax_groups = true when at least one base line carries a tax entry

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts summed are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: The block sums rounded amounts, which is why it agrees with the journal items to the cent.

result.name: the block's untaxed amount and tax amount
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown on the document screen and on the printed page.

edge_cases.case: A base line carries no tax.
edge_cases.outcome: It still counts in the untaxed amount, because the aggregation covers every base line.

edge_cases.case: No base line carries a tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The flag saying that tax groups are involved is false and a single subtotal named "Untaxed Amount" is created with no group.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of one unit at one hundred, one carrying a ten percent tax and the other a five percent tax
worked_examples.narrative: The untaxed amount is two hundred and the tax amount fifteen.

records.name: The base displayed for a tax group
records.purpose: Chooses which figure the totals block shows as a tax group's base, which differs by the computation kind of the taxes that contribute to the group.

operands.name: contributing taxes of the group
operands.source: the tax entries aggregated under the group
operands.constraints: distinct taxes

operands.name: untaxed total and delta of each contributing base line
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax amount of every division tax entry of each contributing line
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the tax details block
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: plain base amount of the group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the aggregation
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: At least one tax entry contributes to the group.
preconditions.otherwise: The group does not exist in the block.

procedure: Collect the distinct taxes that contributed to the group.
When every contributing tax is of the fixed kind, record that there is no displayed base: the value is explicitly absent and the group shows no base at all.

Otherwise, when every contributing tax is of the division kind and every one of them is price-included, set the displayed base to the sum, over the contributing base lines, of the untaxed total plus its delta plus the tax amount of every division tax entry of that line.
Otherwise set the displayed base to the group's plain base amount.

When a displayed base exists, record its textual representation at the currency's precision in the set of encountered bases, which later decides the flag saying that every group shares the same displayed base.
records.formula: displayed_base = absent when every contributing tax is of the fixed kind ; displayed_base = sum over the contributing base lines of ( total_excluded + delta_total_excluded + sum of the tax amounts of the division tax entries of that line ) when every contributing tax is of the division kind and price-included ; displayed_base = the group's plain base amount otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts summed are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency; the textual representation used for the same-base flag is taken at that precision.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: While each group is being assembled, before the subtotals are walked.

result.name: the displayed base of the tax group
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown next to the group's tax amount in the totals block.

edge_cases.case: Every contributing tax is a fixed amount.
edge_cases.outcome: There is no displayed base at all; showing the untaxed total next to a per-unit charge would be misleading.

edge_cases.case: Every contributing tax is a price-included division tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax-inclusive amount is shown, because that is the meaningful base for a tax expressed as a percentage of the total including it.

edge_cases.case: The group mixes computation kinds.
edge_cases.outcome: The plain base amount is shown.

edge_cases.case: Every group and the block's untaxed amount share the same displayed base.
edge_cases.outcome: The flag saying so is set, and a screen may show the base once instead of once per group.

worked_examples.description: A group fed only by a price-included division tax of ten percent on a line of two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: The untaxed total of one hundred eighty plus the division tax of twenty gives the tax-inclusive base of two hundred, which is the figure the customer recognises.

worked_examples.description: A group fed only by a fixed levy
worked_examples.narrative: Every contributing tax is fixed, so the group shows no base at all.

records.name: The cascading base of each subtotal of the totals block
records.purpose: Computes the base and the tax of each subtotal so that a subtotal declared as preceding another behaves like a cascading base: the later subtotal starts from the untaxed amount plus the taxes already accumulated.

operands.name: block untaxed amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax amount of each group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the per-group aggregation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: preceding subtotal label of each tax group
operands.source: the tax group
operands.constraints: the label "Untaxed Amount" is used when the tax group names none

preconditions.condition: At least one tax group was produced.
preconditions.otherwise: A single subtotal named "Untaxed Amount" is created with no group.

procedure: Sort the tax groups by the group's sequence, then by the group's identifier.
Determine, for each group in that order, the subtotal it belongs to: the group's preceding subtotal label when it is set, and the label "Untaxed Amount" otherwise.
Let the first group that names a subtotal fix that subtotal's position in the output order.
Append each group to its subtotal.
Order the subtotals by the recorded positions, then walk them in order keeping a running accumulated tax amount that starts at zero.
Set each subtotal's base amount to the block's untaxed amount plus the accumulated tax amount.
For each group of the subtotal, add its tax amount to the subtotal's tax amount and to the accumulated tax amount.
records.formula: subtotal.base_amount = block.base_amount + accumulated_tax_amount ; for each group of the subtotal : subtotal.tax_amount = subtotal.tax_amount + group.tax_amount and accumulated_tax_amount = accumulated_tax_amount + group.tax_amount

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts added are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: The walk runs after every group has been assigned to a subtotal and before the cash rounding is applied.

result.name: the base amount and tax amount of each subtotal
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown as the subtotal lines of the totals block.

edge_cases.case: No tax group names a preceding subtotal.
edge_cases.outcome: There is one subtotal, named "Untaxed Amount", whose base is the block's untaxed amount.

edge_cases.case: Two groups name the same preceding subtotal.
edge_cases.outcome: Both are appended to it and their tax amounts add into its tax amount; the position was fixed by the first of them.

edge_cases.case: A cash rounding delta exists.
edge_cases.outcome: It is subtracted from the block's untaxed amount and from every subtotal's base amount after this walk, so the rounding shows as its own figure.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of one unit at one hundred, one tax of ten percent with no preceding subtotal and one of five percent whose group names a preceding subtotal
worked_examples.narrative: The group of the ten percent tax is met first, so the subtotal named "Untaxed Amount" takes position zero with a base of two hundred and a tax of ten; the accumulated tax becomes ten, so the second subtotal's base is two hundred ten and its tax five. The grand total is two hundred fifteen.

records.name: The grand total of the totals block
records.purpose: The single figure a document presents as the amount due, built from the block's own three components.

operands.name: block untaxed amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step, after the cash rounding delta has been subtracted
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: block tax amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step, after the non-deductible amounts have been removed and after a cash rounding adjustment of the biggest tax
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: cash rounding delta
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the cash rounding step
operands.constraints: zero when there is none

preconditions.condition: The cash rounding has been decided and the non-deductible amounts removed.
preconditions.otherwise: The grand total would not match the amount the customer has to pay.

procedure: Add the block's untaxed amount, the block's tax amount and the cash rounding delta, in each currency.
records.formula: total_amount = base_amount + tax_amount + cash_rounding_delta , per currency

rounding.what: Nothing new; the three components are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: The last step of the block.

result.name: the grand total
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown as the document total and matched by the sum of the counterpart journal items.

edge_cases.case: There is no cash rounding.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta is zero and the grand total is the untaxed amount plus the tax amount.

edge_cases.case: The cash rounding strategy adjusts the biggest tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta was already folded into the tax amount and into the group's tax amount, and the block's delta is reported alongside so that the total still balances.

worked_examples.description: A block of nine point nine nine untaxed, two point one zero of tax and a cash rounding of one hundredth
worked_examples.narrative: Nine point nine nine plus two point one zero plus one hundredth is twelve point one zero.

records.name: The cash rounding delta taken from existing cash rounding lines
records.purpose: Reports the rounding a saved document already materialised as its own base lines, without recomputing it.

operands.name: rounded untaxed total of each cash rounding base line
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the base lines marked with the cash rounding special type
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: At least one base line carries the cash rounding special type.
preconditions.otherwise: The delta is computed from the configuration instead.

procedure: Sum the rounded untaxed totals of the base lines that carry the cash rounding special type, in each currency.
Record that sum as the block's cash rounding delta and compute nothing else.
records.formula: cash_rounding_delta = sum over the base lines carrying the cash rounding special type of their rounded untaxed totals , per currency

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts summed are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when the rounding line was created.
rounding.step: Before the delta is subtracted from the displayed untaxed amounts.

result.name: the block's cash rounding delta
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown as its own line in the totals block and included in the grand total.

edge_cases.case: Several cash rounding lines exist.
edge_cases.outcome: Their rounded untaxed totals are added together.

edge_cases.case: The document also carries a cash rounding configuration.
edge_cases.outcome: The configuration is ignored: an existing line takes precedence, so the rounding is not applied twice.

worked_examples.description: A saved document with one cash rounding line of one hundredth
worked_examples.narrative: The single line's rounded untaxed total of one hundredth becomes the block's delta.

records.name: The cash rounding delta with the strategy that adds a rounding line
records.purpose: The first cash rounding variant: the difference between the document total and the nearest representable cash amount is shown as its own figure, leaving the taxes untouched.

operands.name: block untaxed amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: block tax amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: cash rounding step
operands.source: the cash rounding configuration
operands.constraints: for example five hundredths

operands.name: cash rounding method
operands.source: the cash rounding configuration
operands.constraints: one of the five rounding methods

preconditions.condition: No cash rounding base line exists yet and a cash rounding configuration was supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The delta is taken from the existing lines instead, or there is no cash rounding at all.

preconditions.condition: The delta is not zero at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing happens and the block reports no cash rounding.

procedure: Round the sum of the block's untaxed amount and tax amount to the document currency, and the same sum in the company currency to the company currency; rounding first prevents a sub-unit residue from being magnified by the step rounding.
Round the document-currency total to the cash rounding step with the configured method to obtain the target total.
Compute the delta in the document currency as the target total less the document-currency total.
Compute the implied rate as the absolute value of the document-currency total divided by the company-currency total, or zero when the company-currency total is zero.
Compute the delta in the company currency as the document-currency delta divided by that rate, rounded to the company currency, or zero when the rate is zero.
Record the delta as the block's cash rounding delta and add it to the block's untaxed amount and to the base amount of the subtotal named "Untaxed Amount", in both currencies.
The later step that subtracts the delta from the displayed untaxed amounts then makes the rounding appear as its own figure rather than distorting the net.
records.formula: total_in_line_currency = round_to_line_currency( base_amount_currency + tax_amount_currency ) ; total_in_company_currency = round_to_company_currency( base_amount + tax_amount ) ; target_total = round_to_step( total_in_line_currency , cash_rounding_step , cash_rounding_method ) ; delta_in_line_currency = target_total − total_in_line_currency ; rate = | total_in_line_currency ÷ total_in_company_currency | , 0 when the company total is 0 ; delta_in_company_currency = round_to_company_currency( delta_in_line_currency ÷ rate ) , 0 when rate = 0

rounding.what: The two totals before the step rounding, the target total, and the company-currency delta.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency for the totals; the cash rounding step for the target.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency roundings; the configured cash rounding method for the target.
rounding.step: The two totals are rounded first, then the target is rounded to the cash rounding step, then the company-currency delta is rounded.

result.name: the block's cash rounding delta
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown as its own line of the totals block and included in the grand total; materialised as a base line carrying the cash rounding special type when the document is saved.

edge_cases.case: The delta is zero at the currency's precision.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing happens and no rounding line is created.

edge_cases.case: The company-currency total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The implied rate is zero and the company-currency delta is zero.

edge_cases.case: The two totals are not rounded before the step rounding.
edge_cases.outcome: A sub-unit floating residue is magnified by the step rounding and the target can land on the wrong multiple.

worked_examples.description: One line of one unit at nine point nine nine with a twenty-one percent price-excluded tax, rounded to the nearest five cents
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve point zero nine rounded to the nearest five cents is twelve point one zero, so the delta is one hundredth. The block reports untaxed nine point nine nine, tax two point one zero, a cash rounding of one hundredth and a grand total of twelve point one zero.

records.name: The cash rounding delta with the strategy that adjusts the biggest tax
records.purpose: The second cash rounding variant: the same difference is absorbed by the largest tax group instead of being shown separately, so the document has no extra line.

operands.name: block untaxed amount and tax amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: cash rounding step and method
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and not applicable
operands.source: the cash rounding configuration
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax amount of each pair of a subtotal and a tax group
operands.source: the per-group aggregation
operands.constraints: the largest in the document currency is chosen

preconditions.condition: No cash rounding base line exists yet and a cash rounding configuration was supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The delta is taken from the existing lines instead.

preconditions.condition: At least one tax group exists.
preconditions.otherwise: The rounding is abandoned and the delta is reset to zero.

preconditions.condition: The delta is not zero at the currency's precision.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing happens.

procedure: Compute the delta exactly as for the other strategy: round the two totals, round the document-currency total to the cash rounding step with the configured method, subtract, and convert the difference to the company currency through the implied rate.
Among every pair of a subtotal and a tax group, pick the one whose tax amount in the document currency is the largest.
Add the delta to that group's tax amount, to that subtotal's tax amount and to the block's tax amount, in both currencies.
When there is no tax group at all, abandon the rounding and reset the delta to zero.
records.formula: the delta is computed as for the rounding-line strategy ; group.tax_amount = group.tax_amount + delta and subtotal.tax_amount = subtotal.tax_amount + delta and block.tax_amount = block.tax_amount + delta , for the pair of a subtotal and a tax group whose tax amount in the document currency is the largest , per currency ; delta = 0 when there is no tax group

rounding.what: The two totals before the step rounding, the target total, and the company-currency delta.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency for the totals; the cash rounding step for the target.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency roundings; the configured cash rounding method for the target.
rounding.step: As for the other strategy; the delta is then added to a tax amount rather than shown on its own.

result.name: the adjusted tax amount of the largest group, of its subtotal and of the block
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown as the group's tax figure; no separate rounding line is produced and no new journal item is created, the largest tax item is adjusted.

edge_cases.case: The document carries no tax group.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounding is abandoned and the delta reset to zero.

edge_cases.case: Two groups share the largest tax amount in the document currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The first of them in the block's order absorbs the delta.

edge_cases.case: The company-currency total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The implied rate is zero and the company-currency delta is zero.

worked_examples.description: One line of one unit at nine point nine nine with a twenty-one percent price-excluded tax, rounded to the nearest five cents
worked_examples.narrative: The delta of one hundredth is added to the single tax group, whose tax becomes two point one one; the block reports untaxed nine point nine nine, tax two point one one and a grand total of twelve point one zero, with no separate rounding line.

records.name: The non-deductible amounts of the totals block
records.purpose: Removes the non-recoverable share from the tax figures the block shows and reports it separately per tax group.

operands.name: non-deductible tax amount of each group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the base lines carrying the non-deductible special type, aggregated by tax group
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: non-deductible base amount of each group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the same aggregation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: tax amount and base amount of each group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the per-group aggregation
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: At least one base line is marked with the non-deductible special type and carries taxes.
preconditions.otherwise: The step does nothing.

procedure: Aggregate the base lines carrying the non-deductible special type by tax group.
For every group of every subtotal, record the group's non-deductible tax amount.
Subtract that amount from the group's tax amount, from its subtotal's tax amount and from the block's tax amount.
Subtract the group's non-deductible base amount from the group's base amount.
records.formula: group.non_deductible_tax_amount = the non-deductible tax amount of that group ; group.tax_amount = group.tax_amount − non_deductible_tax_amount ; group.base_amount = group.base_amount − non_deductible_base_amount ; subtotal.tax_amount = subtotal.tax_amount − non_deductible_tax_amount ; block.tax_amount = block.tax_amount − non_deductible_tax_amount

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts subtracted are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: After the cash rounding and before the grand total.

result.name: the corrected group, subtotal and block tax amounts, and the reported non-deductible tax amount per group
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown on the group's line of the totals block; the corresponding journal item is the one named "private part (taxes)".

edge_cases.case: No line is marked non-deductible.
edge_cases.outcome: Every group keeps its full tax amount and no non-deductible figure is reported.

edge_cases.case: A non-deductible line carries no tax.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not aggregated, because the step only considers lines that carry taxes.

edge_cases.case: The document is not a vendor bill.
edge_cases.outcome: Deductibility below one hundred percent is refused with "Only vendor bills allow for deductibility of product/services.", so no non-deductible line can exist.

worked_examples.description: A vendor bill of one thousand at twenty-one percent with a deductibility of forty percent
worked_examples.narrative: Two hundred ten less one hundred twenty-six leaves eighty-four of recoverable tax, and one thousand less six hundred leaves four hundred of recoverable base; the one hundred twenty-six is reported separately.

records.name: Excluding tax groups from the totals block
records.purpose: Folds selected tax groups into the base so that a jurisdiction can present a tax as part of the price rather than as a separate figure.

operands.name: tax amount of each excluded group
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the per-group aggregation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: base amount and tax amount of the enclosing subtotal
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the subtotal walk
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: base amount and tax amount of the block
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the global amounts step
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The caller named at least one tax group to exclude.
preconditions.otherwise: The helper does nothing.

procedure: For each excluded group, add its tax amount to the enclosing subtotal's base amount and to the block's base amount.
Subtract the same amount from the enclosing subtotal's tax amount and from the block's tax amount.
Remove the group from the block.
Remove a subtotal that is left with no group at all.
records.formula: subtotal.base_amount = subtotal.base_amount + group.tax_amount ; block.base_amount = block.base_amount + group.tax_amount ; subtotal.tax_amount = subtotal.tax_amount − group.tax_amount ; block.tax_amount = block.tax_amount − group.tax_amount ; the group disappears , and so does a subtotal left with no group

rounding.what: Nothing new; the amounts moved are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency and of the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: A post-processing step, after the block has been assembled.

result.name: the folded block
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Shown on the screen or the printed page; the grand total is unchanged, because the amount only moves between the base and the tax.

edge_cases.case: Every group of a subtotal is excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: The subtotal itself disappears.

edge_cases.case: Every group of the block is excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: The block shows the whole amount as the base and a tax of zero; the grand total is unchanged.

worked_examples.description: A block of one hundred untaxed and twenty-one of tax whose single group is excluded
worked_examples.narrative: The twenty-one moves from the tax amount into the base amount, the group disappears and the subtotal left empty disappears too; the grand total stays one hundred twenty-one.

records.name: Mapping a set of taxes through a fiscal position
records.purpose: Substitutes the taxes a product proposes by the taxes the counterpart's situation requires, which is how a domestic rate becomes a reverse-charge pair or an exemption.

operands.name: fiscal position
operands.source: the document, or the automatic detection
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: taxes to map
operands.source: the product or the document line
operands.constraints: an ordered set

operands.name: tax table of the fiscal position
operands.source: built by walking the taxes attached to the fiscal position and recording each attached tax as a replacement of every tax it declares that it replaces
operands.constraints: one replaced tax may expand into several replacements

preconditions.condition: A fiscal position applies to the document.
preconditions.otherwise: The taxes are returned unchanged.

preconditions.condition: The fiscal position has at least one tax attached.
preconditions.otherwise: The result is the taxes that belong to no fiscal position; every tax bound to some fiscal position is dropped.

procedure: Return the taxes unchanged when there is no fiscal position.
Return only the taxes that belong to no fiscal position when the fiscal position has no tax at all.
Otherwise walk the taxes in order and look each one up in the fiscal position's tax table.
Append every replacement the table gives for a tax that is found.
Append the tax itself when it is not found.
Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence.
records.formula: map_tax( fiscal_position , taxes ) : result = taxes unchanged when there is no fiscal position ; result = the taxes that belong to no fiscal position when the fiscal position has no tax at all ; otherwise , for each tax in order , append every replacement it maps to when it is found in the fiscal position's tax table and the tax itself when it is not , then remove duplicates keeping the first occurrence

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The mapping produces a set of taxes, not an amount; the unit price adaptation that follows it is where amounts move.

result.name: the mapped set of taxes
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the document line and handed to the engine.

edge_cases.case: The fiscal position has no tax at all.
edge_cases.outcome: Mapping keeps only the taxes that belong to no fiscal position; every tax bound to some fiscal position is dropped.

edge_cases.case: A replaced tax maps to several replacements.
edge_cases.outcome: All of them are applied to the line, which is how one domestic tax becomes a pair of reverse-charge taxes.

edge_cases.case: Two different source taxes map to the same replacement.
edge_cases.outcome: The duplicate is removed and the first occurrence is kept.

worked_examples.description: A domestic tax replaced by an intra-union reverse-charge tax

inputs.fiscal_position_tax_table: the intra-union reverse-charge tax declares that it replaces the domestic twenty-one percent tax

worked_examples.narrative: The domestic tax is found in the table and is replaced by the single replacement, so the line ends up carrying the reverse-charge tax alone.

records.name: Mapping an account through a fiscal position
records.purpose: Substitutes the account a document line would otherwise use, so that, for example, an export sale reaches the export revenue account.

operands.name: fiscal position
operands.source: the document
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: account
operands.source: the document line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: account table of the fiscal position
operands.source: the fiscal position's account mappings
operands.constraints: one source account may appear only once

preconditions.condition: Each source account appears at most once in the fiscal position's account table.
preconditions.otherwise: The mapping is refused with "An account fiscal position could be defined only one time on same accounts."

procedure: Look the account up as a source in the fiscal position's account table.
Return the mapped destination when it is found.
Return the account itself when it is not.
records.formula: map_account( fiscal_position , account ) = the mapped destination when the account appears as a source in the fiscal position's account table , otherwise the account itself

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The substitution happens before the journal entry is built.

result.name: the account to post on
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the journal item; it is the only account the tax domain changes on a base item.

edge_cases.case: The account is not in the table.
edge_cases.outcome: It is used unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The mapped destination is an off-balance account.
edge_cases.outcome: The line may not carry taxes; the operation is refused with "An Off-Balance account can not have taxes".

worked_examples.description: A domestic revenue account mapped to the export revenue account

inputs.account_table: the domestic revenue account maps to the export revenue account

worked_examples.narrative: The source account is found and the destination replaces it on the line.

records.name: Detecting the fiscal position of a partner and a delivery address
records.purpose: Chooses the fiscal position a new document starts with, from the counterpart, the delivery address and the two parties' tax identification numbers.

operands.name: partner
operands.source: the document
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: delivery address
operands.source: the document
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: tax identification number of the company
operands.source: the acting company
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: tax identification number of the partner
operands.source: the partner
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: member countries of the union group
operands.source: the country group of the economic union
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: There is a partner.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no fiscal position.

preconditions.condition: The partner has a country, when no manually chosen fiscal position is found.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no fiscal position.

procedure: Return no fiscal position when there is no partner.
Set the indication that both numbers are present when the company has a tax identification number and the partner has one.
Set the indication that the transaction is inside the union when both numbers are present and the first two characters of each number are the code of a member country of the union group.
Set the indication that the two numbers share a country prefix when both numbers are present and their first two characters are equal.

Take the partner itself as the delivery address when no delivery address was supplied, or when the transaction is inside the union, the two prefixes are equal and the partner's country equals the company's country.
Return the delivery address's manually chosen fiscal position when it has one, otherwise the partner's when the partner has one.
Return no fiscal position when the partner has no country.
Otherwise search every fiscal position of the acting company whose automatic detection flag is set and return the first match, evaluated against the delivery address.
records.formula: both_numbers_present = the company has a tax identification number and the partner has one ; inside_union = both_numbers_present and the first two characters of the company's number are the code of a member country of the union group and the first two characters of the partner's number are the code of a member country of the union group ; same_country_prefix = both_numbers_present and the first two characters of the two numbers are equal ; the delivery address is the partner itself when no delivery address was supplied , or when inside_union and same_country_prefix and the partner's country equals the company's country

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Detection selects a record, not an amount.

result.name: the detected fiscal position
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the document and used to map its taxes and its accounts.

edge_cases.case: The delivery address carries a manually chosen fiscal position.
edge_cases.outcome: It wins over the partner's and over any automatic detection.

edge_cases.case: Both parties carry numbers of the same union country and the partner's country equals the company's.
edge_cases.outcome: The delivery address is replaced by the partner itself, so a domestic delivery to another address does not trigger a foreign fiscal position.

edge_cases.case: The partner has no country and no manually chosen fiscal position.
edge_cases.outcome: There is no fiscal position.

worked_examples.description: A business in another member country with a valid registration

inputs.partner_country: another member country of the union group
inputs.candidates: one fiscal position with automatic detection on, no country, the union country group and tax registration required

worked_examples.narrative: No delivery address was supplied, so the partner is used. The single candidate requires a registration, which the partner has and which the register marks valid, names no country, and names the union group of which the partner's country is a member; it matches.

records.name: The precedence order and the match test of a fiscal position
records.purpose: Fixes which automatically detected fiscal position wins when several could apply, and the five predicates a candidate must satisfy.

operands.name: number of ancestors of the candidate's company
operands.source: the company tree
operands.constraints: sorted descending

operands.name: sequence of the candidate
operands.source: the fiscal position
operands.constraints: sorted ascending

operands.name: postal code of the counterpart
operands.source: the delivery address
operands.constraints: compared as text against the two bounds

operands.name: state and country of the counterpart
operands.source: the delivery address
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: tax identification number of the counterpart
operands.source: the delivery address
operands.constraints: may be absent

preconditions.condition: A postal code range has both bounds set and the upper bound is greater than the lower one.
preconditions.otherwise: The fiscal position is refused on save with "Invalid "Zip Range", You have to configure both "From" and "To" values for the zip range and "To" should be greater than "From"."

procedure: Sort the candidates by the number of ancestors of their company, descending, so that a fiscal position defined on a branch wins over one defined on its parent.
Sort candidates of equal depth by their sequence, ascending.
Test the tax registration predicate: satisfied when the fiscal position does not require a registration, or when the counterpart's registration is valid for the acting company.
Test the postal code predicate: satisfied when the fiscal position has no complete range, or when the counterpart's postal code lies between the two bounds inclusive, compared as text.
Test the state predicate: satisfied when the fiscal position lists no state, or when the counterpart's state is one of them.
Test the country predicate: satisfied when the fiscal position names no country, or when the counterpart's country is that country.

Test the country group predicate: satisfied when the fiscal position names no group, or when the counterpart's country is a member of the group and either the counterpart has no state or that state is not one of the group's excluded states.
Return the first candidate that satisfies all five.
records.formula: candidates are ordered by ( number of ancestors of the company descending , sequence ascending ) ; the winner is the first candidate for which tax_registration and postal_code and state and country and country_group all hold ; the counterpart's registration is valid means the counterpart has a non-empty tax identification number and , when the cross-border verification applies , the number is also marked valid by the union register

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.method: Postal codes are compared as text, after both bounds have been padded with leading zeros to the longer length when they are entirely numeric.
rounding.step: The padding happens when the range is saved, before any comparison.

result.name: the winning fiscal position
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the document.

edge_cases.case: Two bounds of a postal code range are written with different lengths.
edge_cases.outcome: Both are padded with leading zeros to the longer length before comparison, but only when they are entirely numeric.

edge_cases.case: A fiscal position is defined on a branch and another on its parent.
edge_cases.outcome: The branch's wins, because it has more ancestors.

edge_cases.case: The counterpart has no state and the group excludes some states.
edge_cases.outcome: The country group predicate is still satisfied, because the exclusion is only tested when the counterpart has a state.

edge_cases.case: Cross-border verification applies and the register has not marked the number valid.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax registration predicate fails and the candidate is skipped.

worked_examples.description: A candidate with a postal code range whose bounds are written with different lengths
worked_examples.narrative: Both bounds are numeric, so the shorter is padded with a leading zero to five characters; the counterpart's code lies between them as text, so the predicate holds.

records.name: Adapting the unit price when taxes are substituted
records.purpose: Keeps a stored price meaningful when a fiscal position replaces a price-included tax, so that the customer is charged the right amount rather than the same number.

operands.name: unit price
operands.source: the product or the document line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: original set of taxes
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: new set of taxes
operands.source: the fiscal position's mapping
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The two sets of taxes differ.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is returned unchanged.

preconditions.condition: Every tax of the original set is price-included.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is returned unchanged, deliberately: a mapping from a price-excluded tax to a price-included one leaves the number alone.

procedure: Return the price unchanged when the two sets are identical.
Return the price unchanged when at least one tax of the original set is not price-included.
Compute the original taxes on a quantity of one at the given price, with the round-per-tax method and no special mode, and take the resulting untaxed total as the new price.
Compute the new taxes on that price, at a quantity of one, with the round-per-tax method and the special mode saying the price is the amount without any tax.
Let the delta be the sum of the tax amounts of those new taxes that are themselves price-included.
Return the price obtained in the third step plus that delta.
records.formula: adapted_price = price when the two sets are identical or at least one original tax is not price-included ; otherwise : intermediate_price = untaxed total of the original taxes computed on quantity 1 at price , round per tax , no special mode ; delta = sum of the tax amounts of the new taxes that are price-included , computed on quantity 1 at intermediate_price , round per tax , special mode total excluded ; adapted_price = intermediate_price + delta

rounding.what: The amounts of the two engine runs.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, under the round-per-tax method.
rounding.step: Inside each of the two engine runs; the addition of the delta is exact.

result.name: the adapted unit price
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the document line before the engine computes the line.

edge_cases.case: A price-excluded tax of fifteen percent is mapped to a price-included tax of six percent.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is left alone, so a price of one hundred becomes one hundred divided by one point zero six rather than one hundred six.

edge_cases.case: The new taxes are all price-excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta is zero and the adapted price is the untaxed total of the original taxes.

edge_cases.case: The two sets are identical.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is unchanged and no engine run happens.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example nine: a domestic twenty-one percent price-included tax replaced by an intra-union reverse-charge tax, on a price of one hundred twenty-one

inputs.original_taxes: one domestic twenty-one percent tax, price-included
inputs.new_taxes: one intra-union twenty-one percent tax, price-excluded, whose distribution has one tax line of plus one hundred percent and one of minus one hundred percent

worked_examples.narrative: The original set is entirely price-included, so the adaptation runs. Computing the domestic tax on one hundred twenty-one gives an untaxed total of one hundred. Computing the intra-union tax on one hundred under the special mode gives a tax of twenty-one, but that tax is price-excluded, so the delta is zero and the new price is one hundred. The customer is invoiced one hundred, the ledger nets to zero tax, and the return reports a base of one hundred, a tax due of twenty-one and a deductible tax of twenty-one.

records.name: The price hint shown next to a product price
records.purpose: Builds the short parenthesised text that tells a user what a displayed product price means once its taxes are taken into account.

operands.name: product price
operands.source: the product or the price list
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: sales taxes of the product restricted to the acting company
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: withheld amount
operands.source: a second engine run with withholding taxes enabled, summing the negated tax amount of every withholding tax
operands.constraints: only when the withholding capability is installed

preconditions.condition: The product has at least one sales tax for the acting company.
preconditions.otherwise: The engine run produces totals equal to the price and no fragment is added, so the hint is a single space.

procedure: Run the engine once on a quantity of one at the given price, obtaining the total with taxes and the untaxed total.
Add the fragment naming the total with taxes, followed by the words indicating that taxes are included, only when that total differs from the price at the currency's precision.
Add the fragment naming the untaxed total, followed by the words indicating that taxes are excluded, only when that total differs from the price.

When the withholding capability is installed and the withheld amount is non-zero, add the fragment naming the withheld amount followed by the words indicating a tax withheld, where that amount comes from a second engine run with withholding taxes enabled, summing the negated tax amount of every withholding tax.
Join the fragments by a comma and a space and wrap the result as an equals sign inside parentheses.
Return a single space when there is no fragment at all.
records.formula: fragments = [ total with taxes when it differs from the price , untaxed total when it differs from the price , the withheld amount when it is non-zero ] ; withheld amount = sum over the withholding taxes of ( − their tax amount ) , from a second engine run with withholding taxes enabled ; hint = "(= " followed by the fragments joined by a comma and a space , followed by ")" ; a single space when there is no fragment

rounding.what: The totals of the engine runs and the comparison against the price.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the pricing currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Inside the engine runs; the difference test is made at the currency's precision.

result.name: the price hint
result.unit_or_currency: text carrying amounts in the pricing currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed next to the product price.

edge_cases.case: The product has no sales tax.
edge_cases.outcome: Both totals equal the price, no fragment is produced and the hint is a single space.

edge_cases.case: The tax is price-included.
edge_cases.outcome: The total with taxes equals the price, so only the untaxed fragment appears.

edge_cases.case: The tax is price-excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: The untaxed total equals the price, so only the tax-inclusive fragment appears.

edge_cases.case: The withholding capability is not installed.
edge_cases.outcome: The third fragment never appears.

worked_examples.description: A price of one hundred with a twenty-one percent price-excluded sales tax

fragments: the amount one hundred twenty-one followed by the words indicating that taxes are included
expected_outputs.hint: the single fragment wrapped as an equals sign inside parentheses

worked_examples.narrative: The untaxed total equals the price, so only the tax-inclusive fragment is produced and the hint names one hundred twenty-one.

records.name: The public price of a product
records.purpose: Returns the figure a storefront or a catalogue shows, resolving whether the stored price already contains its taxes.

operands.name: given price
operands.source: the product or the price list
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: sales taxes of the product
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: may be empty

preconditions.condition: The product has at least one sales tax.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is returned unchanged.

procedure: Return the price unchanged when the product has no sales tax.
Compute the taxes on the given price.
Return the resulting total with taxes when it equals the given price, because the taxes are then already included.
Otherwise recompute the taxes forcing the interpretation that the price includes them and return the untaxed total.
records.formula: public_price = price when the product has no sales tax ; public_price = total with taxes of the taxes computed on price , when that total equals price ; public_price = untaxed total of the taxes recomputed on price with the price-included interpretation forced , otherwise

rounding.what: The totals of the engine runs.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the pricing currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Inside the engine runs.

result.name: the public price
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the catalogue and on the storefront.

edge_cases.case: The product has no sales tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The price is returned unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The taxes are already price-included.
edge_cases.outcome: The total with taxes equals the given price and that total is returned.

edge_cases.case: The taxes are price-excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: The forced price-included run returns the untaxed total, which is below the given price.

worked_examples.description: A price of one hundred twenty-one carrying a twenty-one percent price-included tax
worked_examples.narrative: The total with taxes equals the given price, so the taxes are already included and one hundred twenty-one is returned.

records.name: Removing an inapplicable price-included tax from a price
records.purpose: Strips from a price the price-included taxes a product proposes but the document does not use, so that the price the document stores means what the document's taxes say.

operands.name: price
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: taxes of the product
operands.source: the product
operands.constraints: restricted to the given company when one is given

operands.name: taxes of the document
operands.source: the document line
operands.constraints: restricted to the given company when one is given

preconditions.condition: At least one tax of the product is price-included and absent from the document's tax set.
preconditions.otherwise: The price is left unchanged.

procedure: Restrict both tax sets to the given company when a company is given.
Select the product's taxes that are price-included and absent from the document's tax set.
Compute those selected taxes on the price.
Replace the price by the resulting untaxed total.
records.formula: removed = the product's taxes that are price-included and absent from the document's tax set ; price = untaxed total of the taxes in removed computed on price

rounding.what: The untaxed total of the engine run.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: Inside the engine run.

result.name: the corrected price
result.stored_or_displayed: Written on the document line.

edge_cases.case: Every product tax is also on the document.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is removed and the price is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The inapplicable tax is price-excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not selected, because only price-included taxes are inside the price.

edge_cases.case: A company is given.
edge_cases.outcome: Both tax sets are restricted to it before the comparison, so a tax of another company can neither be removed nor prevent a removal.

worked_examples.description: A price of one hundred twenty-one carrying a product tax of twenty-one percent price-included that the document does not use
worked_examples.narrative: The single inapplicable price-included tax is computed on one hundred twenty-one, giving an untaxed total of one hundred, which replaces the price.

records.name: Deciding whether a cash basis entry is needed for a document
records.purpose: Collects the lines of a document that a deferred exigibility affects and decides whether a reconciliation of that document has to produce a cash basis entry at all.

operands.name: balance, residual, amount in document currency and residual in document currency of each term line
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
operands.source: the journal items whose account kind is receivable or payable
operands.constraints: accumulated with a sign of plus one when the balance is positive and minus one otherwise

operands.name: lines that are tax entries of a tax exigible on payment
operands.source: the journal items
operands.constraints: collected with the treatment naming a tax share

operands.name: lines whose flattened base taxes contain at least one tax exigible on payment
operands.source: the journal items
operands.constraints: collected with the treatment naming a base share

operands.name: currencies of the term lines and of the collected lines
operands.source: the journal items
operands.constraints: must be a single currency

preconditions.condition: At least one line was collected and at least one term line exists.
preconditions.otherwise: No cash basis entry is ever produced for this document; the situation is silently skipped.

preconditions.condition: The term lines and the collected lines share a single currency.
preconditions.otherwise: No cash basis entry is produced; the mechanism does not support a document mixing currencies.

procedure: Walk the document's journal items.

Treat a line whose account kind is receivable or payable as a term line and accumulate its balance, its residual, its amount in document currency and its residual in document currency, with a sign of plus one when its balance is positive and minus one otherwise.
Collect a line that is itself a tax entry of a tax exigible on payment with the treatment naming a tax share.

Otherwise collect a line whose flattened base taxes contain at least one tax exigible on payment with the treatment naming a base share; a line can therefore be collected as a base share even though it is itself the tax entry of a different, invoice-exigible tax.
Produce no cash basis entry when nothing was collected or when there is no term line.
Collect the distinct currencies of the term lines and of the collected lines and produce no cash basis entry when there is more than one.
Declare the document fully paid when the total residual is zero in the company currency, or when the total residual in document currency is zero in that currency.
records.formula: total_balance = sum over the term lines of ( sign × balance ) , sign = +1 when the balance is positive and −1 otherwise ; total_amount_currency = sum over the term lines of ( sign × amount in document currency ) ; total_residual and total_residual_currency are accumulated the same way ; fully_paid = is_zero( total_residual , company currency step ) or is_zero( total_residual_currency , document currency step )

rounding.what: The zero tests on the residuals.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency and of the document currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, inside the zero test.
rounding.step: When the document's payment state is evaluated, before the shares are computed.

result.name: the collected lines with their treatments, the term-line totals and the fully-paid indication
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Held while the cash basis entry is composed; the fully-paid indication drives the last-partial correction.

edge_cases.case: The document has no receivable or payable line.
edge_cases.outcome: No cash basis entry is produced; the situation is silently skipped.

edge_cases.case: The document mixes currencies across its term lines and its deferred lines.
edge_cases.outcome: No cash basis entry is produced at all.

edge_cases.case: A line is the tax entry of an invoice-exigible tax but carries a payment-exigible tax among its base taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: It is collected as a base share, so only its base part is deferred.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice of one thousand plus twenty-one percent under deferred exigibility
worked_examples.narrative: The receivable line of one thousand two hundred ten is the single term line; the product line is collected as a base share and the tax line on the transition account as a tax share, so a cash basis entry will be produced on every reconciliation.

records.name: The paid percentage of one partial reconciliation
records.purpose: Determines the share of a document that a partial reconciliation settles, which is the factor every deferred amount is multiplied by.

operands.name: partial amount
operands.source: the partial reconciliation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: partial amount on this document's side
operands.source: the partial reconciliation
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: total balance of the term lines
operands.source: the collection step
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: total amount in document currency of the term lines
operands.source: the collection step
operands.constraints: signed

preconditions.condition: When the document currency is the company currency, the partial amount is not zero in the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: That side of the partial is skipped entirely.

preconditions.condition: When the document currency is not the company currency, the partial amount in document currency is not zero in that currency.
preconditions.otherwise: That side of the partial is skipped entirely.

procedure: Take each of the two sides of the partial reconciliation in turn; on each side, the document is the one on that side and the counterpart is the one on the other side.

When the document currency is the company currency, skip the side if the partial amount is zero in the company currency, and otherwise divide the partial amount by the total balance of the term lines.

Otherwise skip the side if the partial amount in document currency is zero in that currency, and otherwise divide the partial amount in document currency by the total amount in document currency of the term lines.
records.formula: when the document currency is the company currency : percentage = partial_amount ÷ total_balance ; otherwise : percentage = partial_amount_currency ÷ total_amount_currency

rounding.what: The percentage itself is not rounded; only the zero tests that decide whether the side is skipped round.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the company currency or of the document currency, in those zero tests.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The percentage is kept at full precision and applied to each collected line before that product is rounded.

result.name: the paid percentage of this side of the partial
result.stored_or_displayed: Multiplied into every collected line's amount to obtain its share.

edge_cases.case: The partial amount rounds to zero in the relevant currency.
edge_cases.outcome: That side is skipped and no cash basis entry is produced for it.

edge_cases.case: The percentages of several partials do not divide evenly.
edge_cases.outcome: The last-partial correction replaces the last tax share by the tax line's remaining residual, so the shares add back to the document's tax exactly.

edge_cases.case: The document is fully settled by one partial.
edge_cases.outcome: The percentage is one and every share equals the whole deferred amount.

worked_examples.description: A payment of four hundred eighty-four against an invoice of one thousand two hundred ten in the company currency
worked_examples.narrative: Four hundred eighty-four divided by one thousand two hundred ten is exactly zero point four.

worked_examples.description: Three instalments of four hundred three point three three, four hundred three point three three and four hundred three point three four
worked_examples.narrative: The first two percentages are zero point three three three three zero five seven eight and the third is the remainder; the tax shares they give are sixty-nine point nine nine, sixty-nine point nine nine and seventy point zero one, which sum to two hundred nine point nine nine, so the last-partial correction is what brings the total back to two hundred ten.

records.name: The payment rate of a cash basis entry
records.purpose: Fixes the rate that converts each cash basis line from the document currency back into the company currency, so that the entry balances.

operands.name: rate reference amount in document currency
operands.source: the negated document-currency amount of the credit line when this document is the debit side, the document-currency amount of the debit line when it is the credit side, and this document's own line amounts when both sides are themselves invoices
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: rate reference balance
operands.source: the corresponding balance
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: conversion rate at the payment date
operands.unit_or_currency: units of document currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the company's rate table, or the rate the user forced at payment registration
operands.constraints: used only when the two reconciled lines have different currencies

preconditions.condition: The two reconciled lines share a currency and the rate reference balance is non-zero.
preconditions.otherwise: Either the conversion rate of the payment date is used, when the currencies differ, or the payment rate is zero.

procedure: When the two reconciled lines have different currencies, take the conversion rate from the company currency to the document currency, for the company, at the payment date, or the rate the caller forced at payment registration when there is one.
When they share a currency and the rate reference balance is non-zero, divide the rate reference amount in document currency by the rate reference balance.
Otherwise set the payment rate to zero.

Determine the payment date and the settlement date: when both sides are themselves invoices, as for a credit note reconciled against an invoice, the payment date is this document's own date and the settlement date is the later of the two reconciled lines' dates; otherwise both are the counterpart line's date.
records.formula: payment_rate = the conversion rate from the company currency to the document currency , for the company , at the payment date , or the forced rate , when the two reconciled lines have different currencies ; payment_rate = rate_reference_amount_currency ÷ rate_reference_balance when they share a currency and the rate reference balance is non-zero ; payment_rate = 0 otherwise

rounding.what: The rate itself is not rounded.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Each cash basis line's balance is the rounded document-currency share divided by this rate, and that quotient is what the entry stores.

result.name: the payment rate
result.unit_or_currency: units of document currency per unit of company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Used to derive the balance of every cash basis line; never stored on its own.

edge_cases.case: The rate reference balance is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The payment rate is zero and every cash basis balance is zero.

edge_cases.case: Both reconciled sides are invoices, as when a credit note is reconciled against an invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: This document's own line amounts are the rate reference, the payment date is this document's own date and the settlement date is the later of the two lines' dates.

edge_cases.case: The user forced a rate at payment registration.
edge_cases.outcome: That rate is used instead of the rate table's.

worked_examples.description: A payment in the company currency reconciled against an invoice in the same currency
worked_examples.narrative: The reference amounts cancel, so the payment rate is one and each balance equals its document-currency share.

records.name: The shares of a cash basis entry and the last-partial correction
records.purpose: Turns the paid percentage into one amount per collected line, guarantees that the cash basis entries of a fully paid document match its tax to the cent, and groups the shares into as few journal items as possible.

operands.name: amount in document currency of each collected line
operands.source: the journal item
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: paid percentage
operands.source: the paid percentage of the partial
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: payment rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of document currency per unit of company currency
operands.source: the payment rate
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: remaining residual in document currency of each tax line
operands.source: a running residual decremented by each share
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: fully paid indication
operands.source: the collection step
operands.constraints: none

preconditions.condition: The company has a cash basis journal at the moment the first entry is needed.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation is refused with "There is no tax cash basis journal defined for the '<the company name>' company.\nConfigure it in Accounting/Configuration/Settings"

preconditions.condition: Both reconciled documents are posted.
preconditions.otherwise: The entry is created but left in draft until they are.

procedure: Create one journal entry per partial, in the company's cash basis journal, dated on the later of the settlement date and the day after the user's effective fiscal lock date for that journal, referencing the originating document's number, carrying the originating document's fiscal position and linked to the partial reconciliation and the originating document.
For each collected line, multiply its amount in document currency by the paid percentage and round to the document currency.
Divide that share by the payment rate to obtain the balance, or take zero when the rate is zero.

For a line collected as a tax share, replace the share by the line's whole remaining residual when the document is now fully paid or the line's remaining residual in document currency is smaller in absolute value than the computed share, and this is the last partial being processed for that document.
Decrement the running residual of each tax line by each share, so that successive partials never over-allocate.

Group a base share by the currency, the partner, the account, the set of taxes exigible on payment and the analytic distribution; group a tax share by the same key extended with the distribution line.
Add together the shares that share a key, re-deriving debit and credit from the summed balance and summing the base amounts of the tax shares.
For each grouped share, create two journal items in a fixed alternating order, the counterpart first and then the share itself, with consecutive sequence numbers two apart.
records.formula: amount_currency = round_to_line_currency( line.amount_currency × percentage ) ; balance = amount_currency ÷ payment_rate , or 0 when payment_rate = 0 ; for a tax share , amount_currency = the line's whole remaining residual when the document is fully paid or | remaining residual | < | computed share | , and this is the last partial processed for the document ; the running residual of a tax line is decremented by each share

rounding.what: Each share, in the document currency.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the document currency; the balance follows from the division by the payment rate.
rounding.method: Half away from zero.
rounding.step: The share is rounded before the division by the payment rate, and before the last-partial correction is considered.

result.name: the amount in document currency and the balance of each cash basis journal item
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Posted in the cash basis journal as two items per grouped share; the field-by-field content of each item is given in the accounting effects document.

edge_cases.case: The percentages of three instalments do not divide evenly.
edge_cases.outcome: The computed tax shares would be sixty-nine point nine nine, sixty-nine point nine nine and seventy point zero one, summing to two hundred nine point nine nine; the last-partial correction replaces the third by the residual of seventy point zero two so that the three sum to exactly two hundred ten.

edge_cases.case: The payment rate is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Every balance is zero.

edge_cases.case: The company has no cash basis journal.
edge_cases.outcome: The operation is refused with the message naming the company and the settings path.

edge_cases.case: One of the two reconciled documents is still a draft.
edge_cases.outcome: The entry is left in draft until both are posted; a snapshot of what it would contain is stored on the partial reconciliation in the meantime.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example eight, first instalment: forty percent of an invoice of one thousand plus twenty-one percent

items.name: base counterpart
items.account: the company's base tax received account

items.name: base
items.account: the company's base tax received account

worked_examples.narrative: The base share is minus four hundred and the tax share minus eighty-four. Four items are created; the two base items cancel on the same account and exist only to carry the base into the tax return, while the two tax items move eighty-four from the transition account to the real tax account. The counterpart at sequence two is reconciled against the invoice's own tax item, leaving one hundred twenty-six on the transition account.

worked_examples.description: Mandatory example eight, second instalment: the remaining sixty percent
worked_examples.narrative: The computed tax share and the residual agree here, but the correction is what prevents a one-cent drift when the percentages do not divide evenly. The transition account reaches zero and the two tax items become fully reconciled.

records.name: Reconciling the transition account of a cash basis entry
records.purpose: Empties the transition account as the document is paid, by matching each new counterpart item against the original tax item.

operands.name: counterpart item of each tax share
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the cash basis entry
operands.constraints: sits on the transition account

operands.name: original tax item
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the originating document
operands.constraints: must sit on a reconcilable account
