rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers.
rounding.method: Euclidean remainders.
rounding.step: Two remainders per character.

result.name: the carried value
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the country's check.

edge_cases.case: The carried value reaches zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It is read as thirty-six before being doubled, exactly as the eleven-over-ten scheme reads zero as ten.

edge_cases.case: The number contains only digits.
edge_cases.outcome: The scheme still runs, because the digits occupy the first ten positions of the alphabet.

worked_examples.description: The first two steps over a number beginning with the digits one and two
worked_examples.narrative: Twice eighteen is thirty-six, taken modulus thirty-seven that is thirty-six, plus one is thirty-seven, modulus thirty-six is one. Twice one is two, modulus thirty-seven is two, plus two is four, modulus thirty-six is four.

records.name: The modulus ninety-seven over ten primitive
records.purpose: Expands a mixed number of digits and letters into one long whole number and checks its remainder by ninety-seven.

operands.name: characters of the number
operands.source: the normalised number, sometimes preceded by the two-letter country code
operands.constraints: each character's value is taken in base thirty-six

preconditions.condition: Every character is a digit or a letter.
preconditions.otherwise: The expansion is not defined and the country's structural test has already refused the number.

procedure: Replace each character by the decimal writing of its value in base thirty-six, so that a digit becomes itself, the first letter becomes ten, the second eleven and the last thirty-five.
Concatenate the results into one long whole number.
Take that number's remainder by ninety-seven; the number is valid when the remainder is one.
To produce the two check digits instead, append two zeros to the number, take the checksum of the result, and write ninety-eight less that checksum on two digits.
records.formula: expand : replace each character by the decimal writing of its value in base thirty-six ( digits become themselves , the first letter becomes 10 , the second 11 , … , the last 35 ) and concatenate the results ; checksum = the resulting integer mod 97 ; valid when checksum = 1 ; check digits to append = 98 − ( checksum of the number with "00" appended ) , written on two digits

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers.
rounding.precision: Exact, over a number that may be far longer than a machine word.
rounding.method: Euclidean remainder.
rounding.step: One remainder, on the expanded number.

result.name: the checksum, and the two check digits when they are being produced
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the country's check.

edge_cases.case: The expansion produces a number longer than a machine word.
edge_cases.outcome: The remainder must still be exact; an implementation has to carry the remainder digit by digit rather than convert the whole number at once.

edge_cases.case: The number is preceded by its two-letter country code, as the Dutch alternative requires.
edge_cases.outcome: Those two letters are expanded as well, which changes the remainder.

worked_examples.description: Expanding a two-letter prefix
worked_examples.narrative: The letter at position twenty-three of the alphabet expands to twenty-three and the letter at position twenty-one to twenty-one, so the two characters expand to the four digits two, three, two, one before the rest of the number is appended.

records.name: Cleaning a tax identification number
records.purpose: Names the three text operations every country rule composes before its structural test runs.

operands.name: number as typed
operands.source: the user or an import
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: character set to remove
operands.source: the country's rule
operands.constraints: differs per country: spaces, hyphens, full stops, solidi, commas, colons and the two families of Arabic-Indic digit characters all appear

preconditions.condition: The country has a cleaning rule of its own.
preconditions.otherwise: The number is accepted unchanged, because no routine exists for the country.

procedure: Remove every character of the country's character set from the number.
Remove leading and trailing white space when the country's rule says the number is trimmed.
Uppercase the number unless the country's rule says otherwise.
records.formula: cleaned = the number with every character of the country's character set removed , trimmed when the rule says so , and uppercased unless the rule says otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing; cleaning manipulates text.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Cleaning runs before the structural test and before any arithmetic.

result.name: the cleaned number
result.stored_or_displayed: Handed to the structural test and to the check-digit arithmetic; the normalised form is what is stored.

edge_cases.case: Two countries remove different character sets.
edge_cases.outcome: The cleaning has to be implemented per country; a single shared cleaner accepts numbers one country refuses.

edge_cases.case: The rule does not say the number is uppercased.
edge_cases.outcome: The default is still to uppercase; only a rule that says otherwise leaves the case alone.

worked_examples.description: The Swiss example number cleaned of its separators

inputs.characters_removed: spaces are ignored by the application's own check

worked_examples.narrative: The application's own check extracts the nine digits of the enterprise identifier, leaving the hyphen, the full stops and the three-letter tax-regime suffix aside.

records.name: The country normalisation routines
records.purpose: Puts a number into the shape that is stored, which is the shape the country check then runs on and the shape an integration reads back.

operands.name: number after the prefix has been split
operands.source: the pipeline
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: country
operands.source: the pipeline
operands.constraints: nine countries and the union prefix have a normaliser that overrides the country's own compacting routine

preconditions.condition: The country has a normaliser.
preconditions.otherwise: The country's own compacting routine, listed with its check, is used.

procedure: For Albania, split the prefix off, compact the remainder by removing spaces, uppercasing and dropping a leading two-letter country code or the same code in parentheses, then re-join the prefix and the remainder.
For the economic union prefix, return the number unchanged.

For Switzerland, prepend the two-letter country code, apply the formatting of that country, then drop the two leading characters again; the result is the enterprise identifier written with a hyphen and two full stops followed by a space and the three-letter tax-regime suffix.
For Chile, remove full stops, the two-letter country code, spaces and hyphens, uppercase, and then re-insert a hyphen before the last character when more than two characters remain.
For Colombia, apply the formatting, then remove full stops and hyphens, then re-insert a hyphen before the last character when more than two characters remain.
For Vietnam, apply the formatting only when the number matches the ten-digit company pattern, optionally followed by a three-digit branch code, and otherwise leave it alone.

For Hungary, compact the number and then, when it matches the pattern of eight digits, one digit and two digits, re-insert hyphens so that the eight digits, the single digit and the two digits are separated.
For Iceland, split the prefix off, compact the remainder and re-join.
For San Marino, prepend the two-letter country code, compact, then drop the two leading characters.
records.formula: normalised = the country's own compacting routine applied to the number , overridden for Albania , the economic union prefix , Switzerland , Chile , Colombia , Vietnam , Hungary , Iceland and San Marino by the routine stated for each ; for Chile and Colombia : a hyphen is re-inserted before the last character when more than two characters remain

rounding.what: Nothing; normalisation manipulates text.
rounding.method: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Normalisation runs before the check, and the normalised form is what is stored.

result.name: the normalised number
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the partner or on the fiscal position, and returned to the caller together with the validated country code.

edge_cases.case: The number has two characters or fewer under the Chilean or Colombian routine.
edge_cases.outcome: No hyphen is re-inserted.

edge_cases.case: The number does not match the Vietnamese company pattern.
edge_cases.outcome: It is left alone rather than reformatted.

edge_cases.case: The number carries the economic union prefix.
edge_cases.outcome: It is returned unchanged, because such a number is not a national one.

worked_examples.description: The Chilean example number normalised
worked_examples.narrative: The hyphen is removed by the cleaning and re-inserted before the last character, because more than two characters remain.

records.name: The tax identification number check for Albania
records.purpose: Decides whether a number stored for a counterpart established in Albania is a well-formed tax identification number of that country, and what the arithmetic of its check character is.

operands.name: number as typed
operands.source: the partner, or the fiscal position carrying a foreign registration
operands.constraints: the pipeline has already split off any two-letter prefix

operands.name: cleaned number
operands.source: the cleaning stated for Albania: remove spaces and uppercase, then drop a leading two-letter country code or that code written in parentheses.
operands.constraints: exactly ten characters: one letter among J, K, L and M, then eight digits, then one uppercase letter.

preconditions.condition: The pipeline has split the prefix, translated it to a country code and normalised the number.
preconditions.otherwise: The check would run on a shape the country's rule does not describe.

preconditions.condition: The validation mode is not off and the caller did not ask for the check to be skipped.
preconditions.otherwise: The normalised number is returned without being checked.

preconditions.condition: The cleaned number satisfies the structural test: exactly ten characters: one letter among J, K, L and M, then eight digits, then one uppercase letter.
preconditions.otherwise: The check fails; the pipeline retries against the country denoted by the prefix when a union-wide attempt is pending, refuses with the standard message quoting the expected format under the error mode, and returns an empty number under the blank-on-failure mode.

procedure: Clean the number: remove spaces and uppercase, then drop a leading two-letter country code or that code written in parentheses.
Verify that exactly ten characters remain.
Verify that the first character is one of the four permitted letters.
Verify that the next eight characters are digits.
Verify that the last character is an uppercase letter.
Accept the number on its shape alone; no check digit is computed.
records.formula: valid when the cleaned number is exactly ten characters and matches one letter among J, K, L, M , then eight digits , then one uppercase letter ; no check digit

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers and characters.
rounding.method: Every remainder is the remainder of a Euclidean division whose result carries the sign of the divisor, so minus three taken modulus eleven is eight.
rounding.step: Cleaning and normalisation run first; the arithmetic then runs once, on the normalised number, and the normalised form is what is stored.

result.name: the validity indication for Albania
result.stored_or_displayed: The normalised number is stored on the partner or the fiscal position; the validated country code is returned so that a fiscal position requiring a registration can be matched. A failure is reported with the standard message, which quotes the example number `ALJ91402501L`.

edge_cases.case: The number is written with the country code in parentheses.
edge_cases.outcome: The parenthesised code is dropped by the cleaning, exactly like a bare one.

edge_cases.case: No routine exists for the country of the record.
edge_cases.outcome: The number is accepted unchanged; this rule applies only when the country is Albania.

edge_cases.case: The number to return starts with the prefix twice.
edge_cases.outcome: The doubled prefix is treated exactly like a failed check.

worked_examples.description: The example the message quotes
worked_examples.narrative: The two-letter prefix is dropped, leaving ten characters: the letter at the head is one of the four permitted ones, the eight characters that follow are digits and the last is an uppercase letter, so the number is accepted.

records.name: The tax identification number check for Andorra
records.purpose: Decides whether a number stored for a counterpart established in Andorra is a well-formed tax identification number of that country, and what the arithmetic of its check character is.

operands.name: number as typed
operands.source: the partner, or the fiscal position carrying a foreign registration
operands.constraints: the pipeline has already split off any two-letter prefix

operands.name: cleaned number
operands.source: the cleaning stated for Andorra: remove spaces, hyphens and full stops, uppercase, then trim leading and trailing white space.
operands.constraints: eight characters whose first and last are letters and whose six middle characters are digits; the first letter is one of A, C, D, E, F, G, L, O, P and U.

preconditions.condition: The pipeline has split the prefix, translated it to a country code and normalised the number.
preconditions.otherwise: The check would run on a shape the country's rule does not describe.

preconditions.condition: The validation mode is not off and the caller did not ask for the check to be skipped.
preconditions.otherwise: The normalised number is returned without being checked.

preconditions.condition: The cleaned number satisfies the structural test: eight characters whose first and last are letters and whose six middle characters are digits; the first letter is one of A, C, D, E, F, G, L, O, P and U.
preconditions.otherwise: The check fails; the pipeline retries against the country denoted by the prefix when a union-wide attempt is pending, refuses with the standard message quoting the expected format under the error mode, and returns an empty number under the blank-on-failure mode.

procedure: Clean the number: remove spaces, hyphens and full stops, uppercase, then trim leading and trailing white space.
Verify that eight characters remain.
Verify that the first and the last characters are letters and that the six between them are digits.
Verify that the first letter is one of the ten permitted ones.
When the first letter is the one reserved for that class, verify that the six digits do not exceed six hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine.

When the first letter is one of the two letters of the other reserved class, verify that the six digits lie strictly between six hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine and eight hundred thousand.
Accept the number on its shape alone; no check digit is computed.
records.formula: valid when the cleaned number is eight characters , the first and the last are letters , the six in between are digits , the first letter is one of A, C, D, E, F, G, L, O, P, U , and : when the first letter is F the six digits do not exceed 699999 ; when it is A or L the six digits lie strictly between 699999 and 800000 ; no check digit

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers and characters.
rounding.method: Every remainder is the remainder of a Euclidean division whose result carries the sign of the divisor, so minus three taken modulus eleven is eight.
rounding.step: Cleaning and normalisation run first; the arithmetic then runs once, on the normalised number, and the normalised form is what is stored.

result.name: the validity indication for Andorra
result.stored_or_displayed: The normalised number is stored on the partner or the fiscal position; the validated country code is returned so that a fiscal position requiring a registration can be matched. A failure is reported with the standard message, which quotes the example given for the country.

edge_cases.case: No routine exists for the country of the record.
edge_cases.outcome: The number is accepted unchanged; this rule applies only when the country is Andorra.

edge_cases.case: The number to return starts with the prefix twice.
edge_cases.outcome: The doubled prefix is treated exactly like a failed check.

worked_examples.description: The two numeric bounds the rule states
worked_examples.narrative: Six hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine is the largest value the six digits may take for that first letter; seven hundred thousand would fail.

worked_examples.description: A first letter of the other reserved class
worked_examples.narrative: Seven hundred thousand lies strictly between six hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine and eight hundred thousand, so the range test passes.

records.name: The tax identification number check for Argentina
records.purpose: Decides whether a number stored for a counterpart established in Argentina is a well-formed tax identification number of that country, and what the arithmetic of its check character is.

procedure: Clean the number: remove spaces and hyphens.
Verify that eleven digits remain and that the first two are one of the ten permitted pairs.
Apply the ten weights to the first ten digits and add the products.
Take the remainder of that sum by eleven.

Read the character at the position given by eleven less that remainder in the twelve-character string, whose odd tail makes a remainder of ten give a zero and a remainder of eleven give a nine, as the national rule requires.
Compare that character with the eleventh digit.

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers and characters.
rounding.method: Every remainder is the remainder of a Euclidean division whose result carries the sign of the divisor, so minus three taken modulus eleven is eight.
rounding.step: Cleaning and normalisation run first; the arithmetic then runs once, on the normalised number, and the normalised form is what is stored.

result.name: the validity indication for Argentina, together with the check character the arithmetic produces
result.stored_or_displayed: The normalised number is stored on the partner or the fiscal position; the validated country code is returned so that a fiscal position requiring a registration can be matched. A failure is reported with the standard message, which quotes the example number `20055361682`.

edge_cases.outcome: The number is accepted unchanged; this rule applies only when the country is Argentina.

edge_cases.outcome: The doubled prefix is treated exactly like a failed check.

procedure: Clean the number: remove spaces, hyphens and full stops, uppercase, then drop a leading country code.
Verify that nine or ten digits remain; refuse any other length.

For nine digits, weight each of the first eight by its own position, add the products, take the remainder by eleven, and when that remainder is ten repeat with each position increased by two; the check digit is the remainder taken modulus ten and must equal the ninth digit.
For ten digits, try the national personal number rule first, then the foreigner's number rule, then the plain weighted rule, and accept when any of the three succeeds.

For the national personal number rule, verify that the first six digits encode a date of birth with the stated month offsets, then apply its own nine weights and take the remainder by eleven and then by ten.
For the foreigner's number rule, apply its own nine weights and take the remainder by ten.
For the plain rule, apply the nine weights, subtract the sum from eleven and take the remainder by eleven.

records.purpose: Decides whether a number stored for a counterpart established in Saudi Arabia is a well-formed tax identification number of that country, and what the arithmetic of its check character is.

preconditions.condition: The pipeline has split the prefix, translated it to a country code and normalised the number.
preconditions.otherwise: The check would run on a shape the country's rule does not describe.

preconditions.condition: The validation mode is not off and the caller did not ask for the check to be skipped.
preconditions.otherwise: The normalised number is returned without being checked.

preconditions.condition: The cleaned number satisfies the structural test: exactly fifteen digits beginning and ending with the same reserved digit.
preconditions.otherwise: The check fails; the pipeline retries against the country denoted by the prefix when a union-wide attempt is pending, refuses with the standard message quoting the expected format under the error mode, and returns an empty number under the blank-on-failure mode.

procedure: Clean the number: no cleaning beyond the pipeline's own is applied; the application supplies its own check.
Verify that exactly fifteen digits remain.
Verify that the first and the last digit are the reserved one.
Accept the number on its shape alone; no check digit is computed.
records.formula: valid when the number matches exactly fifteen digits beginning and ending with a three ; no check digit

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is over whole numbers and characters.
rounding.method: Every remainder is the remainder of a Euclidean division whose result carries the sign of the divisor, so minus three taken modulus eleven is eight.
rounding.step: Cleaning and normalisation run first; the arithmetic then runs once, on the normalised number, and the normalised form is what is stored.
